news.Title: 台股重挫逾千點、外資續站賣方，新台幣走弱貶2.9分收32.889元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週四新台幣兌美元匯價走貶，市場對聯準會12月升息預期加溫，推動週三美元指數上揚，不過主要亞幣週四漲跌互見，台幣偏弱交投，同時，台股震盪殺跌，加權指數重挫1,165點或2.63%，外資持續外流，週四賣超上市股票6.8億元，也不利台幣匯價行情。新台幣兌美元匯率週四以32.889元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率貶值2.9分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.850元，最低成交價為32.994元，成交量為16億5,100萬美元。

輝達公司股價週三盤後大跌，投資者開始面對一種可能性，那就是輝達掌門或許不再是首席執行長黃仁勳，因有消息指稱，輝達董事會正準備撤換黃仁勳，這對供應鏈將是一個非常棘手的局面。

隨著市場日益擔憂人工智能(AI)交易的強勁態勢及其持續性，輝達股價本已承受壓力。輝達定於11月17日公佈季度業績。

news.Title: 黃仁勳爆「小四」台股重挫！郭哲榮霸氣喊話：別管八卦AI根本停不下來
news.Content:
台股今（12）日呈現大幅震盪走低格局，終場重挫1,165.28點，收在43,091.87點，跌幅達2.63%，成交金額爆出新台幣1兆132.93億元天量。市場盛傳大跌元凶是外媒再爆輝達（NVIDIA，美股代號：NVDA）執行長 黃仁勳 捲入「第二起婚外情」，導致 輝達 盤後股價急挫逾8%。對此， 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮（哲哲） 直言「沒那麼無聊」，強調台股只是短線反彈逾6,000點後的正常休息，AI產業發展根本停不下來，更霸氣重申年底挑戰5萬點的目標不變！

【黃仁勳再爆桃色風波 輝達盤後急挫逾8%】

根據《紐約時報》（New York Times）引述5名輝達（NVDA）前員工的匿名爆料指出，黃仁勳除了先前因涉入與中國相關女性的婚外情遭到調查外，據傳還與一名直接向他匯報的高階主管發展出另一段婚外情，而這名未曾曝光的對象，正是輝達醫療保健事業部副總裁 鮑爾（Kimberly Powell） 。

由於美國眾議院委員會主席表示準備針對國安疑慮發出傳票，市場也傳出董事會正在評估撤換執行長人選，雙重利空衝擊輝達（NVDA）盤後股價一度重挫約8%至9%，下探158.78美元附近，連帶引發今日台股賣壓出籠。

【大跌千點免驚！郭哲榮：反彈6千點休息很正常】

面對市場恐慌情緒，摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮在節目中直接點破：「台股今天是在跌黃仁勳的八卦嗎？沒那麼無聊好嘛！」他指出，從上週低點算起，台股短短四個交易日已經強勢反彈超過6,000點，就像他昨天提前預告的，大盤在經歷強勁V轉過後，稍微喘口氣、休息整理非常正常。

郭哲榮也對投資人心態喊話，直言許多人上週怕崩盤不敢買，這週又怕漲太多，等到今天拉回依然不敢進場，「那乾脆退出股市算了！」他強調，上週台股殺到3萬7千點附近時，自己便真金白銀砸下5,000萬元買進最後一筆元大台灣50（0050），前後共投入高達2億元資金，並精準預告國安基金進場與V轉行情，如今看來幾乎買在波段最低點。

news.Title: 台股4天暴衝6600點後急跌 分析師揭一大敗象：國安基金恐沒轍
news.Content:
台股短短一個月大跌逾1萬2000點，本周展開強勢反攻，今（12）日盤中最高來到44525.24點，短短4個交易日累計反彈逾6600點，不料午盤過後風雲變色，指數賣壓急遽湧現，終場大跌1165點，市場將跌勢與輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大連結。對此，承通投顧副總陳嘉偉在個人YouTube頻道示警，認為台股真正值得關注的是盤面結構轉弱，尤其近期反彈過程持續出現「無量反彈」，顯示市場追價意願不足，後續恐仍有修正壓力。

陳嘉偉表示，這波台股最值得注意的警訊，在於國安基金護盤效果可能不如市場預期，他分析，過去國安基金進場護盤，多半是在指數接近五年線，甚至十年線等相對低檔位置時出手，但這次卻在年線附近進場。他示警，若市場趨勢持續向下，即使投入資金護盤，也未必能夠扭轉空方走勢。

陳嘉偉進一步指出，近期台股反彈過程中，成交量並未同步放大，甚至出現指數上漲、成交量卻逐漸萎縮的現象，在他看來，這種無量反彈代表市場追價動能不足，若缺乏實質買盤支撐，指數仍可能再度面臨賣壓。

陳嘉偉更認為，若台股形成M頭等技術型態，後續恐再度回測年線，以目前指數位置推算，修正幅度可能達5000點，甚至進一步進入主跌段。

個股方面，陳嘉偉表示，近期PCB族群雖然部分個股早盤仍有買盤進場，但隨著大盤由紅翻黑，南電、景碩、聯茂等個股賣壓明顯加重，部分甚至逼近跌停。記憶體族群方面，南亞科、旺宏、力積電等股票近期雖受市場題材及產業消息帶動而走強，但在大盤急轉直下後，股價同樣面臨明顯修正壓力。

至於AI伺服器族群，技嘉、廣達等個股也同步重挫逾5%。陳嘉偉認為，即使企業釋出AI伺服器需求持續成長等正面訊息，但股價未能進一步走強，反而出現開高走低的情況，可能代表市場對相關利多的反應已逐漸鈍化。

陳嘉偉近期多次示警，並以「完美風暴」形容當前金融市場環境。他認為，若台股技術面正式形成M頭，後續恐面臨更大幅度的修正，甚至進一步下探五年線，不排除跌破25000點。

news.Title: 輝達跌倒沒在怕！「這檔概念股」超妖 連拉4根漲停板
news.Content:
輝達執行長黃仁勳2度爆出婚外情，輝達盤後股價重挫超過8%。台股輝達供應鏈也受影響，台積電、鴻海收黑，健策更慘遭打入跌停，不過在一片慘綠中，板卡廠麗臺力抗頹勢，逆勢攻漲停亮燈，連續拉出四根漲停，股價創波段新高。

台股歷經上週的大跌後強勢反彈，今（12）日早盤雖然上漲逾200點，但翻黑後跌幅迅速擴大，尾盤收43091點，重挫1165點，跌幅2.63%，成交量則略增至1.01兆，輝達概念股更成為重災區，健策跌停，奇鋐下挫8.72%，廣達、緯穎重挫逾6%，台達電跌逾4%，台積電、緯創也下跌逾2%。

值得一提的是，同為輝達夥伴的顯卡廠麗臺（2465），並未受到輝達重挫牽連，麗臺為輝達亞太地區的主要代理商，根據9日公布的財報，麗臺第三季每股盈餘4.03元、年增1037.21％，前三季累計每股賺6.82元、年增74.77倍；股價受強勁基本面支撐，自11月9日起連續拉出4根漲停板，股價也從百元出頭來到164元，累積漲幅破35%。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股暴跌1165點失守44000點！美股大漲卻逆勢重挫 5大可能下跌原因
news.Content:
台股12日上演劇烈震盪，儘管前一晚美股四大指數全面收紅，台股卻逆勢走弱，終場收在43,091.87點，大跌1,165.28點、跌幅2.63%。

市場關注輝達（NVIDIA）相關爭議、AI族群評價壓力、權值股賣壓及日韓股市同步走弱等因素，以下整理五大可能原因。

輝達執行長黃仁勳醜聞連環爆 引發下台危機

繼日前坦承婚外情，對象疑似為涉入情報活動的女子黃樂後，外媒今日進一步踢爆黃仁勳與直屬的輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑爾（Kimberly Powell）亦有不倫戀，嚴重觸犯企業內部利益衝突與公司治理紅線。

市場傳出輝達董事會正針對其去留進行緊急討論，不排除啟動接班或罷免程序，消息一出導致輝達美股盤後重挫逾7%至8%，直接重擊市場對AI龍頭領導層穩定度的信心。

華爾街投行集體下修輝達評價

由於黃仁勳任期不確定性、美國出口管制調查以及AI資本支出疑慮同步升高，多家華爾街大行接連調降輝達評價。

其中，知名機構Bernstein將輝達評等降至「與大盤持平」，並將目標價從400美元大砍一半至200美元；摩根士丹利與美國銀行也相繼將輝達移出首選名單，加劇了全球半導體與AI供應鏈的調節賣壓。

台積電與AI權值股淪為外資提款機

儘管台積電ADR昨晚大漲4.25%，但台北現股今日未能延續漲勢，開低走低成為壓盤重心，台積電終場下跌55元、收在2340元，跌幅2.30%。

由於台廠與輝達供應鏈高度綁定，包括廣達、鴻海、台達電、奇鋐與京元電等AI概念股同步遭到外資大舉調節，引發盤面多殺多效應。

昨日大漲逾1500點後的獲利了結賣壓

台股昨日（11日）才剛上演報復性反彈，單日狂飆1545點。

在短線反彈幅度已大、部分搶短資金本就尋求出場之際，又逢國際重大利空突襲，導致獲利了結賣壓迅速出籠，加速指數由紅翻黑並一路向下摜壓。

亞股同步開高走低 引發外資區域性提款連鎖效應

今日亞洲主要股市全面走弱，日經平均指數早盤開高至61475.11點後翻黑下挫，截至下午2時38分下跌418.13點、報60830.46點（跌幅0.68%）；韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）同樣開高走低，截至下午2時37分下跌48.18點、報5327.18點（跌幅0.90%）。

由於台、日、韓同為全球AI與半導體供應鏈重鎮，外資機構在亞太區同步收緊風險部位，並將流動性極佳的台股視為變現提款機，進一步放大了盤中跌勢。

今日重挫主要源於單一龍頭企業的治理與政治風險引發系統性恐慌，而非AI產業基本面全面反轉。

後續台股能否止跌回穩，除了須緊盯輝達董事會的正式決議外，外資在台積電的賣超力道是否趨緩，以及日韓股市能否率先止穩，將是盤面最關鍵的觀察指標。

news.Title: 難敵台股史上最慘10月！已有6家券商虧錢 「他」逆風年增576%
news.Content:
台股於10月面臨劇烈震盪，加權指數相較於9月底的47,940點，單月重挫高達2,729點，一舉刷新台股史上「最慘10月」跌點紀錄。隨著主要券商近期陸續公布10月自結獲利，大盤大幅回檔對券商自營部門與承銷部位造成顯著衝擊，目前已揭曉業績的8家券商中，有6家單月和去年相比，出現「由盈轉虧」。

觀察10月單月營運表現，多數中小型與綜合券商受大盤急跌拖累，自營操作與有價證券評價損失擴大。在已公布的8家券商中，包含美好證、致和證、統一證、福邦證、大展證及宏遠證等6家單月均陷入虧損，且與去年同期相比皆呈現「由盈轉虧」。

其中，以致和證虧損幅度最深，單月稅後淨損達12.38億元。

至於單月仍維持獲利的業者，表現也出現明顯分歧。永豐金證券10月稅後純益為3.7億元，較去年同期衰退逾三成；群益證單月獲利年減幅度更超過八成。

相較之下，龍頭與特定券商則展現強勁抗跌力道，成功在逆風中突圍。元大證券單月營運未受台股劇烈震盪波及，10月稅後純益高達43.79億元，較去年同期逆勢成長逾九成；康和證單月表現更為強勁，稅後純益年增率突破576%，成為10月獲利成長最突出的券商。

儘管10月單月面臨逆風，但拉長至今年前十月來看，受惠於今年以來台股累計上漲16,248點，市場交投熱絡推升經紀手續費收入大幅成長，加上前三季自營與承銷業務累積的豐厚獲利基礎，全數券商累計獲利仍大幅超越去年同期。

統計今年前十月累計稅後純益年增率，以宏遠證表現最為亮眼，前十月稅後純益達13.98億元，年增率高達838.26%；大展證居次，前十月稅後純益5.95億元，年增率亦達523%。

此外，統一證、福邦證、群益證、致和證及永豐金證等前十月累計獲利年增率皆突破100%大關，美好證累計年增率也有六成以上水準，顯示券商整體年度基本面依然穩健。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股重挫1165點！ 網見外資買賣全傻眼：也太誇張
news.Content:
台股今（12）日上演慘烈殺盤，早盤一度上漲逾200點，隨後卻急轉直下，賣壓一路擴大，終場大跌1165點，以43091點作收，跌幅2.63%，成交量突破1兆元。值得注意的是，三大法人今日合計買超51.59億元，其中外資僅小幅賣超6.84億元，與大盤重挫形成強烈反差，讓網友忍不住直呼：「到底誰在賣？」

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計買超51.59億元。其中外資及陸資賣超6.84億元，自營商方面，自行買賣賣超29.80億元、避險賣超35.60億元，兩者合計賣超65.40億元；投信則逆勢買超123.85億元，成為今日買盤主力。值得注意的是，台股今日重挫逾千點，成交量更突破1兆元，但外資賣超金額僅約6.84億元，與大盤跌勢並不成比例，也讓市場關注究竟是哪股賣壓造成指數急殺。

觀察投信買超排行，金融股成為布局重心，中信金（2891）以買超1萬2225張居冠，國泰金（2882）買超6021張、富邦金（2881）買超6017張，分居第二、第三名。其他買超標的還包括統一（1216）買超6004張、元大台灣50（0050）買超3900張、台玻（1802）買超3511張，以及群益ESG投等債0-5（00985B）買超2984張。此外，大成鋼（2027）、富邦特選高股息30（00900）及南亞（1303）也進入買超前10名。

至於投信賣超部分，台新新光金（2887）遭砍1萬6090張，成為賣超冠軍，凱基金（2883）賣超1萬25張、玉山金（2884）賣超9952張，兆豐金（2886）也遭賣超8066張。電子股方面，聯電（2303）遭賣超7464張，英業達（2356）賣超7167張，元大金（2885）賣超5496張；另外，陽明（2609）、文曄（3036）及慧洋-KY（2637）也進入投信賣超前10名。

台股重挫逾千點，但外資僅小幅賣超，此舉讓PTT網友看傻眼，紛紛留言：「誰在賣？」、「不是，到底誰？」、「賣6億，台股跌一千多點？」、「+51億，跌1200點，怎麼有這麼多恐慌蛙散戶？也有人認為，市場恐慌情緒可能引發散戶多殺多，直言「散戶跑光光」、「稍微有風吹草動，大家都跑很快」、「散戶自己驚恐大賣」、「笑死，大媽互踩」、「今天阿呆谷」。

news.Title: 員工個資外洩？台積電：無證據顯示系統遭入侵
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 15:13:36 新聞中心 發佈

媒體報導稱有駭客在地下論壇公開兜售疑似台積電(2330)員工個人資料，宣稱握有高達4.6萬筆紀錄，對此，台積電今(12)日證實發現部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被放置於外部網站，但強調目前沒有證據顯示公司自身資訊系統遭到入侵，這次遭公開的資訊也不涉及公司生產或客戶相關資料。

台積電表示，公司發現部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被放置於外部網站，經初步了解，這些資訊與某家雲端服務供應商系統服務中的資料相符，目前沒有證據顯示台積電自身資訊系統遭到入侵。

台積電強調，這次遭公開的資訊並不涉及公司生產或客戶相關資料。公司已陸續通知受影響人員，提供必要協助，同時與相關雲端服務供應商、調查機關及第三方網路安全機構密切合作，加速釐清事件原因，並採取必要措施。

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資連11賣卻大幅縮手！今僅砍6億元 分析師：開始翻多了
news.Content:
台股今（12）日重挫1,165點，外資僅賣超6.84億元，連續11個交易日累計提款8,312.52億元。資深台股分析師蔡明翰表示，近期台股連續反彈，外資態度已逐漸轉向偏多，不過目前仍處於信心較脆弱的階段，若美股半導體跌勢擴散，仍可能重新轉趨保守。

外資賣超縮手能否轉買？分析師：已有偏多跡象

蔡明翰表示，外資操作通常比大盤反應慢約3至4天。台股前幾個交易日連續反彈，市場情緒逐漸由悲觀轉向偏多，但外資仍持續賣超，直到今日才明顯縮手。他認為，外資目前已有轉向偏多的跡象，但由於才剛開始調整，信心仍相對脆弱。

蔡明翰指出，外資後續能否由賣轉買，仍須觀察輝達（NVIDIA）相關事件對美股的影響，尤其跌勢是否擴散至其他半導體股。若跌勢進一步擴大，外資可能重新轉趨保守；反之，若影響未擴散，外資後續買盤則有機會更加積極。

至於自營商今日賣超65.40億元，蔡明翰認為，自營商部位相對較小，操作偏向短線，通常跟隨市場走勢調整，難以單獨左右大盤方向。他指出，今日台股下跌的關鍵並非賣壓特別沉重，而是先前連續反彈後，市場追價意願降低，買單明顯減少，進一步放大跌勢。

台股大跌逾千點 三大法人逆勢買超51億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計買超51.59億元。其中，外資今日縮手僅提款6.84億元，已呈連11賣，累計賣超8312.52億元。

投信也延續買超，投信今日合計買超123.85億元，呈連23買。

自營商則是由買轉賣，今日賣超65.40億元，其中自行買賣賣超29.80億元，避險操作賣超35.60億元。

台股今日終場收在43,091點，下跌1,165點，失守4萬4千點大關，成交量約1.04兆元。權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,340元，下跌55元。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: 輝達要換新CEO? 台股巨震1581點又回防4萬3
news.Content:
[ 非凡新聞 ]記者黃友柔,攝影謝隆証

輝達相關爭議持續延燒，衝擊台股表現，今（12）日早盤雖然一度衝上44525點，不過隨後指數一路走低，最低下探42943點，高低震盪將近1600點。電子權值股普遍疲弱，台積電、聯發科還有台達電通通收黑，儘管玻纖布還有光電族群逆勢撐盤，最後仍不敵空軍賣壓，指數終場下跌1165點，收在43091點，成交量大約1.01兆元。

加權指數一下上、一下下，就像一張狂跳的心電圖，上漲好開心、翻黑又擔心。儘管美股周三集體收紅，但是輝達受到利空消息干擾，盤後一度暴跌9%，導致台積電股價跟著疲弱，聯發科、台達電也陷入整理，大盤上沖下洗，44000點得而復失。

第一金投顧董事長 黃詣庭：「從上周五的低點到昨天收盤，其實已經上漲超過6400點，相較之下這一波從高到低大概跌了12000點，也就是說本波反彈已經是跌幅的一半以上，所以開始會有一些調節性的賣壓開始出籠，再加上說上方開始又會面臨到均線的反壓。（但）目前來看的話本波反彈是非常的強勁，主要還是受到國安基金進場，還有就是金管會的禁空令讓市場信心回復，再加上美股有回穩的現象，科技股出現反彈所帶動。」

盤面上強勢走高族群，包括面板股友達上揚，華通受惠Space X題材上漲，高階玻纖布需求強勁。不過另一方面，在MSCI明晟公布最新半年度調整後，景碩、南電、台燿都從小型股指數升級至標準指數，股價卻重挫，而相關調整預計11月30後收盤後生效。

好在從籌碼面來看，外資態度似乎悄悄出現轉變。

兆豐投顧董事長 留政鈺：「昨（12）天外資基本上賣壓已經縮減到8億元以下，今年以來外資賣超3.02兆，以及11月大概就賣6500億。不過比較好的是，台積電基本上昨天外資是買了142億，買了6038張，那今年以來外資賣超台積電是2.28兆，所以第一個台積電是外資賣壓止跌的一個訊號，那第二個是今天早上MSCI的一個調整，基本上比較好的是權重調整、調高0.03百分點。」

隨著美國期中選舉消息面因素逐漸弱化，加上市場對於雲端服務業者的投資成本上升疑慮淡化，專家認為台股基本面堅實，年底前高點仍然可期。（記者黃友柔、謝隆証／台北採訪報導）

news.Title: 〈台股收盤〉電子權值賣壓沉重、盤中大怒神影響 終場重挫1165點險守4萬3千點
news.Content:
台股今(12)日早盤受費半狂飆近6％激勵，一度漲逾260點，隨後賣壓出籠，盤中受輝達黃仁勳陷入婚外情醜聞及間諜指控影響，輝達展開調查，新聞傳出有撤換黃仁勳的職務可能，也讓權王台積電(2330-TW)及電子權值股翻黑影響，指數急速下探，最低一度失守4萬3千點整數關卡，指數高低點差距高達1,582點，終場下跌1165.28點或2.63%，收43,091.87點，終結日K連4紅，成交量增至1.01兆元。

觀察今日盤面上，電子權值股在盤中受賣壓沉重影響，多檔由紅翻黑，僅玻纖布上游、CCL、金融股及中小型IC設計類股表現逆勢抗跌。

盤面上，護國神山台積電今日盤中由平盤翻黑，尾盤跌幅加劇，終場下跌2.3%或55元，收2,340元失守半年線；聯發科(2454-TW)跌3.51%、台達電(2308-TW)跌4.25%、 鴻海(2317-TW)跌0.83%、聯電(2303-TW)跌2.8%、致茂(2360-TW)漲3.65%。

上游高階玻線布、銅箔基板(CCL)因受惠於AI需求強勁，傳出漲價及缺料風險，包括台玻(1802-TW)漲6.52%，敬鵬(2355-TW)、定穎投控(3715-TW)雙雙逆勢收漲停，無畏大盤翻黑重挫影響逆勢上揚。

金融股部分，今日在盤中漲幅劇烈下，也成為資金暫時避風港之一，包括中信金(2891-TW)、永豐金(2890-TW)、第一金(2892-TW)、元大金(2885-TW)皆收紅盤。

高價股方面，受大盤修正影響，包括散熱股健策(3653-TW)收跌停，欣興(3037-TW)跌8.33%，聯茂(6213-TW)收522元、也亮燈收跌停板。

分析師表示，指數在大漲4天後出現漲多回檔翻黑，觀察融資餘額在國安基金進場後，近期持續增加，也讓大盤在短線上震盪狀況合理，盤中這波向下修正力道又急又快，也反映出指數反彈上揚後，有獲利投資人想要提早下車。展望未來，台股在未來經過籌碼整理過後，仍有機會再向上攻堅。

news.Title: 護國神山也中招！4.6萬員工個資疑遭外流 台積電回應了
news.Content:
近期國內接連出現重大資安事件，晶圓代工龍頭台積電（2330）也中招！傳出台積電員工個資疑遭駭客外流。有駭客於地下論壇聲稱掌握4.6萬筆、約6.9GB的台積電員工資料，並以3枚比特幣（約新台幣740萬元）作為標價，且揚言若一週內未成交，將公開所有資料。

對此，台積電於今（12）日作出回應，強調經初步調查，目前並無證據顯示公司內部系統遭到入侵。台積電指出，洩漏的資訊與某雲端服務供應商的系統資料相符，並強調受影響資料與公司生產或客戶相關資訊無涉，主要涉及部分現職及離職員工的個人資料。

台積電表示，目前已陸續通知受影響人員，並主動提供相關協助，公司也積極與該雲端服務供應商、調查機關以及第三方網路安全機構密切合作，加速釐清事件狀況並採取必要應對措施。台積電重申，將持續強化資訊安全機制，全力維護員工隱私與公司資安。

news.Title: 輝達董事會將決定黃仁勳去留＋PCB載板賣壓出，台股翻黑重挫2.63%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】輝達董事會傳出準備撤換執行長黃仁勳，最快今天開會決定去留。輝達週三盤後一度重挫8%，亞股今（12）日因此一路走低。截至台股收盤，日經指數下跌412.16點，跌幅0.67%，暫報60,836.43點；韓國KOSPI下跌1.18%，暫報5,311.89點。 台股開低後一度翻紅，加權指數今日最高衝上44,525.24點，午後賣壓擴大，終場下跌1,165.28點，收43,091.87點，跌幅2.63%，成交金額10,133億元，從盤中高點回落超過1,400點。櫃買指數也翻黑，下跌8.38點，收335.73點，跌幅2.44%。權值股全面走弱：台積電(2330)下跌55元，收2,340元，跌幅2.30%；聯發科(2454)下跌140元，收3,850元，跌幅3.51%；台達電(2308)下跌55元，收1,240元，跌幅4.25%；聯電(2303)下跌3元，收101元，跌幅2.88%。

PCB與ABF載板族群跌得最重，南電(8046)收972元、景碩(3189)收667元，雙雙跌停，欣興(3037)跌8.33%，臻鼎-KY(4958)跌6.72%。CCL族群的聯茂(6213)跌停，台燿(6274)跌9.81%，台光電(2383)跌8.78%，南亞(1303)跌6.39%。被動元件方面，禾伸堂(3026)跌停，華新科(2492)跌5.56%，國巨*(2327)跌4.12%。記憶體族群中，華邦電(2344)跌6.59%，群聯(8299)跌5.49%，南亞科(2408)跌3.68%。矽光子族群的上詮(3363)跌6.59%，光聖(6442)跌5.98%，華星光(4979)跌5.30%，聯亞(3081)跌5.19%。面板級封裝的日月光投控(3711)跌5.02%，群創(3481)跌4.31%。逆勢走強的只剩少數個股：玻纖布龍頭台玻(1802)大漲6.52%，敬鵬(2355)漲停，健鼎(3044)漲2.69%，友達(2409)漲1.92%，波若威(3163)漲1.14%。

根據外電報導，輝達董事會傳出正與外部獵才公司合作，物色可能接替黃仁勳的執行長人選，並評估任命臨時執行長的可能性。AI大廠CoreWeave財報優異並大舉調升展望，帶動科技股買盤強勢回歸，昨晚費半飆升5.66%，台積電ADR大漲 4.25%。美國10月CPI走高推升利率疑慮，聯準會政策仍是變數。而南亞董事會決議斥資115.3億元在彰濱投資，加碼高階玻纖布布局，也是值得關注焦點。

總結來說，台股連三天反彈累計超過4,500點後，今天因黃仁勳去留未定而出現獲利了結，漲多的AI載板與材料股首當其衝。輝達董事會的決議出爐前，短線震盪恐怕還沒結束，不宜急著追價。

news.Title: 輝達概念股慘綠！台股收跌1165點 法人曝後市三劇本
news.Content:
台股今（12）日開高走低，盤中雖一度上漲逾200點，但翻黑後跌幅迅速擴大，尾盤以43091點作收，下跌1165點，跌幅2.63%，成交量來到1.01兆元；台積電、鴻海等一票輝達概念股也綠一片，唯獨金融股收紅撐盤。

進一步觀察輝達概念股，受黃仁勳再爆出第2起婚外情影響，輝達盤後股價重挫8%，連帶影響台廠輝達概念股也下挫，台積電下跌55元，收2340元，跌幅2.3%，鴻海來到240元，下跌0.83%，健策跌停，奇鋐下挫8.72%，廣達、緯穎重挫逾6%，台達電跌逾4%，緯創也下跌逾2%。

針對黃仁勳近期捲入桃色風波，國泰證券期貨分析師郭經緯表示，未來有三大走向：

第一， 調查疑慮解除、沒違反國安法 ：黃仁勳安全下樁，此將激勵輝達概念股強勁反彈，但認為發生機率最低。

第二， 風暴擴大，黃仁勳被迫請辭 ：發生機率約40%，輝達供應鏈全面承壓，台股不排除回測11月6日的低點37837點，打出第二隻腳。

第三， 黃仁勳退居幕後 ：留任董事長但交出執行長職務，發生機率最高。若管理層順利交接，台積電、AI伺服器與零組件可望回歸訂單及獲利基本面，市場信心逐步修復。

news.Title: 台股收盤／台積電跌55元！台股慘跌1165點　類股又一片慘綠
news.Content:
美股週三（11日）四大指數全面收紅，AI概念股強勢反彈，未料台股今（12）日不漲反跌，盤中賣壓持續擴大，尾盤更出現明顯殺盤。加權指數終場收在43,091.87點，大跌1,165.28點，跌幅2.63%，失守43,100點關卡，成交金額高達1兆132.93億元；代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步走弱，終場收在335.73點，下跌8.38點，跌幅2.44%，成交金額2,783.19億元。兩市合計成交金額達1兆2,916.12億元。

美股四大指數齊揚　台股開高後賣壓湧現

美股週三（11日）四大指數全面收高，AI雲端業者CoreWeave第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，激勵股價飆漲近25%，帶動人工智慧（AI）概念股反彈。輝達結束連續兩個交易日跌勢，那斯達克指數上漲1.60%，費城半導體指數更勁揚5.66%，為科技股帶來反彈契機。

不過，美股科技股反彈氣勢未能延續至台股。從今日盤勢觀察，加權指數早盤一度向上反彈，但隨後賣壓逐漸湧現，指數由紅翻黑，上午11時後跌勢進一步擴大，午後更一路向下探低，終場收在43,091.87點，接近當日低檔。

台股今日成交金額突破兆元，顯示市場交投相當熱絡，但指數卻大幅下挫，反映高檔震盪加劇，資金調節壓力沉重。權王台積電（2330）下跌55元，收在2,340元，聯發科、南亞、南亞科等電子權值及記憶體股同步走弱，拖累大盤重挫逾千點，市場呈現價跌量增格局。

倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，盤中指數一度上漲268點、上探至44525點；不過，由於美AI監管政策不確定性尚未消除，外資期貨空單居高不下、現貨一路調節動作不斷，加上AI晶片霸主黃仁勳桃色風波愈演愈烈，盤後股價應聲暴跌逾9%，以及月線與季線蓋頭反壓，仍有待時間化解，，台股連5日大漲6688點後，雖然在利空未除、以及市場信心尚未完全恢復過來之前，短線上將有震盪拉回整理的必要，且下檔於11/9日止跌長紅K棒40347~41661點區間附近有撐下，預期11月行情將可望處在於40000~45000點區間反覆震盪、個股輪動表現的機率居多，投資方向將由過去缺料漲價與題材推升，轉向基本面升級、技術門檻提高及實際訂單成長；首先是ASIC與AI伺服器，Google TPU、AWS Trainium及NVIDIA Vera Rubin陸續放量，帶動IC設計服務、伺服器組裝與高速互連需求；其次是高階PCB、CCL、ABF載板及先進封裝，隨M8/M9材料升級、晶片封裝面積擴大及製程難度提高，具備高階產品認證與實際量產訂單的廠商，將持續擴大獲利；第三是CPO、NPO及矽光子，隨800G、1.6T光通訊產品滲透率提升，高速光互連將成為降低傳輸功耗的重要技術方向；第四是半導體設備、廠務工程及矽晶圓，受惠先進製程與記憶體新廠陸續量產，帶動設備及材料需求成長，因此，面對指數處於40000~45000點區間反覆震盪的過程中，策略上除了宜把握「急漲不追、急殺不空」的原則。

news.Title: 台股2大原因收盤慘跌1165點！台積電殺55元 AI族群全倒
news.Content:
台股3天急漲逾6千點，今（12日）短線漲多回吐，加上輝達執行長黃仁勳面臨下台危機，恐牽動台灣供應鏈後市，引發市場出現獲利了結賣壓，台股終場下跌1165.28點收在43097.87點失守44K，成交值約1兆元。權值股台積電跌55元或2.30%收在2340元，台達電跌55元4.25%收在1240元，聯發科挫低140元3.51%收在3850元。

台股開高走低，盤中一度上漲268點觸及44525.24點，但接近午盤時陸續出現賣壓，尾盤更是一路走低，資金轉入金融、電信及內需族群，電子股再成提款機，記憶體與PCB族群跌勢劇烈，欣興下跌逾8.33%收在792元，南電與景碩被打入跌停，南亞科下跌逾3%，華邦電也跌逾6%。

人工智慧與半導體族群後市存在變數，輝達執行長黃仁勳外遇共諜黃樂之後又被爆出不倫戀，與輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell）有親密關係，華爾街日報則披露，輝達董事會準備撤換黃仁勳，盤後股價應聲下殺7%。

若黃仁勳真的下台，台股將受到直接衝擊，影響股價、客戶信心和訂單能見度。另有一層擔憂，黃仁勳長期頻繁來台、與台廠互動密切，若他離開，輝達與台鏈的合作關係可能出現微妙變化，後市存在不安定因素。

知名分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）預估，如果黃仁勳被解職，輝達的市值可能會瞬間損失高達30%。目前輝達內部最有可能的繼任者為財務長克雷斯（Colette Kress）與超大規模與高效能運算部門的副總裁巴克（Ian Buck）其中巴克的看好度較高。

news.Title: 台積電驚傳個資外洩！駭客開賣4.6萬筆員工資料 公司緊急回應
news.Content:
暗網論壇傳出有駭客兜售4.6萬筆台積電員工個資，開價3枚比特幣（約合新台幣740萬元），並威脅1周內無人購買將全面公開。台積電今（12）日證實部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被置於外部網站，但強調目前無證據顯示公司內部系統遭入侵，外洩資料與某雲端服務供應商的系統服務相符，且不涉及生產與客戶機密。

根據網路流傳資料，有駭客在兩大地下論壇DarkForums、BreachForums公開拍賣疑似為台積電員工的個資，釋出名為「tsmc.txt」的樣本檔案，共包含499筆資料，每筆涵蓋19個欄位，內容涵蓋姓名、生日、職稱、國籍、身分證字號，以及住址、手機號碼、Email、銀行資訊等個資，就連緊急聯絡人的電話、住址等也都完整呈現。

面對資安疑慮，台積電說明，經內部清查後確認公司系統並未遭到入侵，這批外流的員工資料與某雲端服務供應商的系統服務資料相符，與公司晶圓生產製造及客戶相關機密資料完全無關。

台積電表示，目前已陸續通知受影響的現職及離職員工並提供必要協助，同時正與該家雲端服務供應商、相關調查機關及第三方網路安全機構密切合作，加速釐清外洩源頭並採取必要防範措施，後續將持續強化員工隱私與資訊安全防護。

news.Title: 【台股3萬8抄底大調查2】台股3天絕地反攻7檔權值股漲贏大盤！散戶「押對寶」南亞狂噴30%奪冠 台達電也成大贏家
news.Content:
台股6日盤中一度跌至3萬8字頭，不過這周台股強勢反彈，短短三個交易日從上漲約4,555點，漲幅約11.47%。回顧十大權值股同期間表現，對飆大盤為「7勝3敗」，值得注意的是，光是10大權值股在上周就狂吸23萬散戶入場，其中又以股東人數大增、大戶減少的南亞在3天反彈中內飆出三成以上漲幅，成為散戶「押對寶」的代表作之一，而漲幅超過22%的台達電也在眾多權值股中脫穎而出成為亞軍。

台股急跌期間，前十大權值股股東人數卻逆勢增加。據統計，10月30日至11月6日，十檔個股總股東人數合計淨增加23萬1,476人，其中台積電增加7萬3,812人最多，聯發科增加5萬3,716人居次，台達電、欣興及南亞也分別增加逾2.6萬人。

而以十大權值股這周3日急彈期間股價表現，則以南亞（1303）從239.5元上漲至313元，三個交易日大漲30.69%，居十檔之冠。

至於台達電（2308）則以漲幅22.75%居第二；股東人數增幅近一成的欣興（3037）則飆出漲幅18.84%，獲得大量股東進場接盤的個股紛紛繳出驚人表現。

此外，大戶撤離的台光電（2383）及聯發科（2454）也分別上漲17.80%、17.70%，均明顯優於同期大盤約11.47%的漲幅。

日月光投控（3711）則上漲17.08%，台積電（2330）上漲12.18%，同樣跑贏大盤。

值得注意的是，南亞在這波反彈中表現最為強勢，但回頭檢視10月30日至11月6日集保資料，400張以上股東人數減少5人，1,000張以上股東也減少4人，但總股東人數卻在逆勢大增2.6萬人。

換言之，南亞在股災期間大戶持股呈現調節，股價卻在隨後三個交易日強勢反彈逾三成，顯示不少散戶在大戶出脫的谷底「押對寶」。

不過當然也有部分個股反彈幅度未跟上大盤，如鴻海股價從上周五收盤224.5元反彈至11日的242元，三個交易日漲幅僅7.80%，不僅低於大盤，也落後多數科技權值股。

至於大戶逆勢增加的金融股，富邦金（2881）上漲7.77%、國泰金（2882）上漲6.6%，同樣未能跟上大盤，大戶避險之下反倒錯失反彈狂飆的行情。

news.Title: 【台股3萬8抄底大調查1】股災來襲「千張大戶」買什麼？聯發科、台光電大戶撤退 日月光、富邦金反成避風港
news.Content:
台股11月6日盤中一度跌破3萬8千點，市場經歷劇烈震盪，不過，從集保中心最新股權分散統計來看，這波修正期間，千張大戶布局出現明顯分歧。據統計，前十大權值股中，千張大戶逆勢增加的個股以日月光投控（3711）最明顯，單周增加7人、增幅1.65%，富邦金（2881）也增加5人、增幅0.95%；反觀聯發科（2454）、台光電（2383）等科技股，千張大戶人數減幅居前。

本次統計以10月30日、11月6日集保中心股權分散資料為基準，鎖定台積電（2330）、聯發科（2454）、台達電（2308）、鴻海（2317）、日月光投控（3711）、南亞（1303）、富邦金（2881）、國泰金（2882）、台光電（2383）及欣興（3037）等前十大權值股，分別觀察1,000張以上大戶人數及總股東人數變化，掌握市場急跌期間的股東結構變化。

台股谷底千張大戶買什麼？日月光增加7人居冠　富邦金也增5人

從千張大戶人數來看，這波台股修正期間逆勢增加的個股並不多，其中日月光投控由425人增加至432人，單周增加7人、增幅1.65%，是十檔權值股中增加最多的標的。

富邦金則由增加5人、增幅0.95%。其餘個股中，國泰金維持683人，鴻海則減少3人、減幅0.36%，顯示千張大戶在部分大型權值股及金融股的布局相對穩定。

反觀減少幅度，聯發科千張大戶減少5人、減幅2.18%，是十檔中減幅最大者；台光電減少1人、減幅1.64%，台達電則減少3人、減幅1.13%。

欣興、南亞也分別減少2人、4人，減幅為1.00%、1.01%。整體來看，千張大戶在這波修正期間，對科技股的布局相對保守，反而是日月光投控、富邦金等個股出現人數增加。

對此，凱旭投顧分析師王士維認為，大戶在股災過程相對保守觀望，但因國安基金宣示護盤，股價近期反彈相對強勢，帶動投資人心理層面信心。散戶看的是產業基本面信仰，只要股價打折，心理就會認為超跌，加上國安基金進場，所以短線超跌勢必會有反彈。

王士維也強調，外資大幅賣超過程，大戶法人有風控與年底績效壓力，逐步撤出部分科技權值股，目前國際情勢尚未明朗前，大戶靜待觀望，目前買超都鎖定ETF，也顯示外資眼中主流未完全顯現。

運達投顧分析師陳石輝也認為，大戶並不願在外資提款、接連破底的過程中強抄過去漲多的科技股，因此選擇相對漲幅小、風險低的部分科技股與金融股，寧可少賺一根漲停板也不去承擔後續的破底風險。

news.Title: Micron vs. Sandisk: The AI Memory Supercycle Is Big Enough for Both, but Here's the Better Buy.
news.Content: Memory has been one of the biggest stories of 2026. Prices have surged as memory has become one of the biggest bottlenecks in the artificial intelligence (AI) build-out. This has impacted not just the cost of AI data centers, but also the cost of smartphones, PCs, and other electronic devices. This has benefited the stocks of both Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) and Micron (NASDAQ: MU), which have been two of the market's biggest winners ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Sandisk (SNDK) and Micron (MU) have benefited significantly from the AI memory supercycle, with Sandisk shares up over 200% and Micron up around 150% year-to-date.
• The AI build-out has created a bottleneck in memory, driving up prices for both DRAM (Micron) and NAND (Sandisk) due to high demand for AI data centers and consumer electronics.
• Micron derives approximately 73% of its revenue from DRAM and 26% from NAND, while Sandisk is a pure-play NAND manufacturer.
• High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), a special form of DRAM, is in high demand, manufactured using EUV lithography, leading to competition for capacity among DRAM makers like Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix.
• Both companies are seen as attractive buys with extremely low forward P/E ratios of 4 times or less, benefiting from secular AI tailwinds and long-term deals.
news.Keywords: AI memory, DRAM, NAND, HBM, secular tailwinds

news.Title: 台積電資安風暴？驚傳近5萬筆個資遭開價740萬拍賣 官方急聲明
news.Content:
台灣資安事件連環爆，連護國神山台積電也捲入其中！有駭客在地下論壇兜售聲稱是台積電的員工個資，包含6.9GB、共4.6萬筆紀錄，開價約台幣740萬元，並威脅一周內沒賣出就全面公開。對此，台積電緊急回應，目前無證據顯示公司內部系統遭入侵，外洩資料與生產及客戶無關，研判是某雲端服務供應商的系統資料外流，已陸續通知受影響的現職與離職員工提供協助，並聯手調查機關與資安機構全力追查。

今天台積電遭爆有駭客在地下論壇點名「台積電（TSMC）」，拍賣詳細個資。賣家聲稱取得6.9GB共4.6萬筆員工紀錄，開價3 BTC，折合台幣 740萬元，還表示如果一周沒找到買家，就公開全部資料。

台積公司發現部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被置於外部網站，目前並無證據顯示台積公司系統遭到入侵。已知這些資訊與某雲端服務供應商之系統服務中的資料相符，且與公司生產或客戶相關資料無關。台積公司已陸續通知受影響的人員並提供其必要的協助。同時，我們正與相關雲端服務供應商、調查機關，及第三方網路安全機構密切合作以加速釐清狀況並採取必要措施。台積公司將持續致力於保護同仁隱私與維護資訊安全。

news.Title: 台股ETF受益人突破2千萬/創高 28檔同步寫新猷
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 13:03:37 新聞中心 發佈

台股ETF投資人勇者無懼，大跌大買。上周大盤共跌掉5510.19點，跌幅12.19%，並創下史上最大單周跌點紀錄。但台股ETF受益人數連續4周創新高，總人數突破2000萬大關。根據集保戶股權分散11月6日最新統計資料顯示，台股ETF受益人數周增49.2萬人，總人數來到2025萬403人，統計今年來增加了807萬6913人。以單檔人數變化來看，包括元大台灣50（0050）、群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）、群益台灣精選高息（00919）、元大高股息（0056）及群益半導體收益（00927）等共28檔台股ETF受益人數同步創高，整體來看正二、高息型、市值型人氣相對旺。

群益投信台股ETF研究團隊表示，以台股來說，台股上周已經拉回整理一波，是逢低分批布局的好時點，穩健投資人可以台股高息ETF為核心配置穩固資產；積極型投資人可以趁大幅回檔買入正二，但台股正2 ETF的運作機制為每日重新平衡，當市場下跌時，資產縮水的幅度也會被加倍放大，投資人須考量自身理財目標與投資屬性，控制好投資風險，分批佈局參與第四季投資契機。

群益臺灣加權正2(00685L) ETF經理人洪祥益表示，台股呈現高檔震盪格局，產業輪動快速，不過中長期而言，台股都還具資金吸引力，營收表現佳、具題材性及成長性的個股仍有機會引領盤勢上攻，因此對於想透過槓反ETF來掌握台股趨勢的投資人而言，看好中長線的投資人可逢低分批布局槓桿型ETF。

群益台灣精選高息(00919)暨群益半導體收益(00927) ETF基金經理人謝明志表示，台股基本面有撐，長線來看，每次回檔都是中長線成長的佈局良機。對投資人而言，面對大盤大漲大跌的情況，建議投資人可以選擇有息收保護、波動相對個股低的台股高息型ETF。高息型ETF成分股波動度相對可控，以長期存股投資目的為前提下，現階段倒是投資人逢低分批布局的好時機。

news.Title: 台股3天狂彈逾11%！它飆超過20%　勇奪績效雙冠王
news.Content:
加權指數連三日大幅反彈逾11%，重返4萬4000點關卡之上，台股受惠美國科技股反彈，加上國安基金宣示護盤加持下，投資人信心大振，買盤大舉回籠，帶動台股ETF勁揚，11/11單日漲幅前四強主動台新臺灣中小（00416A）、主動兆豐台灣豐收（00996A）、主動台新優勢成長（00987A）、主動群益核心50（00415A）等四檔台股ETF皆大漲逾5%，其中，主動台新臺灣中小（00416A）除了單日大漲5.87%高居第一外，近三日累計漲幅亦是唯一超過2成的台股ETF，奪績效雙冠王。

前波歷經AI的雜音大震盪，致台股自10月中旬歷史高點5萬點附近向下大幅回檔2成以上，科技股快速修正，許多個股投資價值浮現，台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金（00416A）經理人沈建宏表示，國安基金進場加強信心面，且融資在短時間內瘦身有成，籌碼面有利反彈。就基本面分析，CSP雲端業務持續成長強勁，算力需求暢旺，第四季仍為AI相關零組件之出貨旺季，多數個股在2027年仍有獲利翻倍成長機會，另一方面，護國神山台積電10月合併營收較去年同期大增59.7%，創下今年以來單月營收新高，強化投資人對AI需求的信心，台股後市漲升行情持續看俏，短線遇回檔皆是逢低布局良機。

長期而言，AI趨勢並未發生重大反轉，基本面強勁，沈建宏指出，AI族群2027年營運動能有望持續成長。另外，過去20年台股11月到隔年第一季上漲機率高，仍會反映隔年作夢行情，因此在系統性風險後台股無須悲觀，仍應擇優布局。跌深的中小利基股可望率先走強，操作上，應留意新題材與輪漲，看好AI供應鏈受惠如材料升級、電力革新、新設計等；光通訊供應鏈；關鍵零組件；半導體上游材料與設備；美國設廠受惠股；漲價族群如被動元件、電源IC、矽晶圓；高股息殖利率族群等。

news.Title: 台股震盪逾600點！正2 ETF規模突破3千億元大關
news.Content:
輝達執行長黃仁勳因桃色風波面臨職位保衛戰，市場關注長期夥伴台積電先進製程及CoWoS先進封裝訂單，是否受到黃仁勳去留影響，台積電12日股價表現疲軟，早盤跌40元、來到2355元，指數最低43878點，高低震盪逾600點；不過，台股自上周五6日最低下探3萬7878點、失守年線以來，漲了約6500點， 元大台灣50正2(00631L)規模正式突破3000億元大關。

聯發科、台達電12日仍持續上攻，聯發科股價突破4000元大關、漲幅一度超過3％，最高來到4120元，台達電站上1300元，最高來到1335元，指數最高來到4萬4525點。

台股本周強力反彈與資金挹注下，正2 ETF同步狂漲，帶動00631L規模成長突破3000億元，再為台股槓桿ETF創下全新里程碑。

據證交所、集保結算所數據，00631L於4月16日、6月12日規模分別突破1,000億元及2000億元，11月11日規模再突破達3185億；累積今年以來至11月6日當周，獲得2220億淨申購，投資人數同步增加35.2萬至39.1萬人。

00631L標的指數為臺灣50指數，在指數單日正向兩倍報酬操作目標下，淨值走勢與臺灣50指數高度相關，且在行情趨勢明確如波段上漲或波段下跌時，複利效果可望使00631L漲得比0050的兩倍還多，但下跌則會比0050的兩倍少。

以實際表現來看，據Lipper統計00631L成立以來至2026年10月底績效3652％，為同期間臺灣50指數含息報酬率888％的4.11倍；槓桿設計雖使00631L波動度較0050高，但同期間報酬風險比兩者均為0.95，顯示在槓桿報酬下，未過度承擔波動風險；不過，元大投信提醒，正2 ETF適合可以持續留意行情變化的投資人，操作時須謹慎評估並嚴設停損規劃。

news.Title: 黃仁勳若下台 亞股殺血海！台灣巨頭京元電子曝險36％最危險 名單一次看
news.Content:
輝達執行長黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大，除了疑似共諜黃樂（Alice Huang）之外，還有48歲的女下屬，醫療保健事業副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell），讓黃仁勳陷入下台危機。若真的遭到免職，亞洲供應鏈將面臨直接衝擊，台灣以半導體測試巨頭京元電曝險佔比最高達36%，台積電則存在19%的業務曝險，但金額最為龐大。

深層危機是台鏈友好關係遭割捨

綜合外媒報導，京元電子承接高階晶片的測試業務，去年財報顯示單一最大客戶的營收佔比達36%，雖未公開為輝達，但從法人研究報告、供應鏈與法說會內容推算，輝達扮演重要角色。

台積電也是主要受災戶，輝達為旗下最大客戶，營收佔比為19%，去年貢獻台積電新台幣7,269.74億元營收。除了京元電與台積電之外，輝達在緯創的營收佔比預估也有21%，鴻海、日月光、廣達、緯穎、景碩、欣興與和碩等供應鏈都被列入觀察。

日、韓也是海嘯第一排

國際大廠方面，日本Ibiden佔比約29%，SK海力士有27%營收依賴輝達，日本Advantest則有22%受衝擊，南韓Leeno也有17%。台廠受到衝擊的主要原因是，黃仁勳離開後輝達的股價、客戶信心和訂單能見度。

另有一層擔憂，黃仁勳長期頻繁來台、與台廠互動密切，若他離開，輝達與台鏈的合作關係可能出現微妙變化，後市存在不安定因素。輝達與黃仁勳目前並未正式說明第二段婚外情的質疑，華爾街日報則披露，輝達最快今召開董事會討論黃仁勳的去留。

黃仁勳外遇女下屬恐成壓倒駱駝的最後一根稻草，圍繞在國安、洩密、企業治理與企業倫理的質疑，董事會若沒有詳盡說明並調整公司組織，難以服眾。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】指數攻上44500點　玻纖布概念股強勢
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年11月12日電）台股今天開低震盪，盤中一度失守44000點，最低下探43878.52點，隨後翻紅，最高來到44525.24點，高低震盪逾600點。權王台積電 (2330) 一度下跌40元，盤中跌幅收斂，為2390元，下跌5元。玻纖布概念股、機器人概念股表現亮眼。

10時55分左右，加權指數為44347點，上漲90點，漲幅0.2%，成交值約新台幣5528億元。電子類股指數上漲0.1%，金融類股指數上漲0.08%，櫃買指數上漲1.9%。

權值股盤中漲跌互見，鴻海 (2317) 今天將舉行第3季法人說明會，盤中上漲1.5元至243.5元；聯發科 (2454) 上漲75元至4065元；台達電 (2308) 上漲10元至1305元；廣達 (2382) 下跌9元至289元。

玻纖布概念股盤中走強，台玻 (1802) 攻上漲停84.3元，德宏 (5475) 、富喬 (1815) 、建榮 (5340) 皆漲逾2%。

機器人概念股盤中表現活躍，彬台 (3379) 攻上漲停36.3元；大銀微系統 (4576) 一度攻上漲停213.5元，隨後打開，盤中上漲逾8%；樺漢 (6414) 、銘異 (3060) 皆上漲逾4%。

資深證券分析師簡伯儀接受中央社記者電訪表示，台股本週前3個交易日在台積電帶動下大漲，而今天盤中部分權值股拉回，櫃買指數漲勢較明顯，顯示資金開始轉向中小型股。

簡伯儀認為，輝達執行長黃仁勳的去留傳聞，可能影響台股上攻力道，不過台股整體盤面氣氛依然偏樂觀。

news.Title: 台股早盤震盪後翻紅，櫃買指數強漲逾2%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】亞股早盤呈現震盪格局，韓國KOSPI指數盤上震盪，三星電子與SK海力士則維持相對強勢。三星電子盤中上漲約3.19%，SK海力士上漲約1%，顯示記憶體及半導體個股仍有買盤支撐。日本日經225指數則上漲約450點，走勢相對穩定。台股方面，昨日大漲1545點後，今日早盤呈現高檔震盪，加權指數以44180.46點開出，早盤一度下探43878.52點，隨後買盤回流，指數由黑翻紅。上午盤中最高一度來到44525.24點，回升至44400點附近，漲幅0.4%。櫃買指數表現更為強勢，盤中來到352.57點，漲幅逾2.2%，顯示中小型股資金動能優於大型權值股。

權值股方面，台積電(2330)盤中報2375元，下跌20元、跌幅0.84%，面臨短線獲利了結壓力；聯發科(2454)報4090元，上漲100元、漲幅2.51%；台達電(2308)報1320元，上漲10元。

族群方面，被動元件持續受到市場關注，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)及禾伸堂(3026)為盤面觀察重點，市場持續留意AI伺服器帶動高階MLCC需求的後續效應。

PCB及CCL族群則受惠AI伺服器、高速傳輸與高階交換器需求，台光電(2383)、台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)及金像電(2368)持續受到資金關注。ABF載板方面，欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、景碩(3189)為主要觀察指標，短線需留意前一交易日大幅反彈後的獲利了結壓力。矽光子與光通訊族群方面，聯亞(3081)、上詮(3363)、華星光(4979)及波若威(3163)仍是市場關注焦點，AI資料中心高速光傳輸需求仍是中長期重要題材。

整體而言，台股今日呈現指數震盪、中小型股相對強勢的格局。加權指數能否站穩44000點，以及櫃買指數能否延續強勢，將是盤面觀察重點。尤其輝達突發人事消息，可能影響AI供應鏈短線評價，投資人應留意台積電、聯發科及PCB、ABF、矽光子族群的資金流向，避免在消息面不確定時過度追價。

news.Title: 黃仁勳再爆「小四」 台積電訂單遭殃？專家點名致命威脅不是他
news.Content:
輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳再爆第2段不倫戀，恐面臨下台危機，讓全球AI產業供應鏈繃緊神經，由於輝達是台積電的重要客戶，黃仁勳又在台灣擁有高人氣，外界關注這場高層風波是否會衝擊台灣半導體產業。不過，美國媒體《Business Insider》引述多位產業分析師指出，即使黃仁勳真的離開輝達，短期內也不太可能撼動台積電，真正值得關注的風險，反而是美國政府對大陸晶片出口管制政策的變化。

報導指出，台積電目前掌握全球超過九成最先進晶片製造，去年營收達1220億美元，輝達更是其重要客戶之一。不過，市場研究機構Counterpoint Research資深分析師威廉李（William Li）表示，先進製程晶圓的需求遠遠超過任何單一企業高層的個人影響力，目前也沒有跡象顯示輝達正在放慢腳步，或實際削減對台積電的訂單。

Gartner新興市場動態部門副總裁兼首席分析師古普塔（Gaurav Gupta）也指出，目前看不出黃仁勳風波對台積電造成實質影響，在全球AI基礎設施需求持續強勁、晶片產能供應有限的情況下，台灣半導體供應鏈在AI產業的核心地位，短期內仍難以被取代。除非後續調查影響投資人信心，或導致企業放緩AI資料中心建置，否則短期內台積電及台灣供應鏈不至於受到明顯衝擊。

分析認為，真正可能波及台灣的因素，並非黃仁勳是否下台，而是美國政府是否進一步收緊晶片出口管制，並加強查緝高階晶片違規轉運至大陸的情況。若相關政策升級，可能影響輝達營收，進而對供應鏈帶來連鎖效應。

針對此篇報導，輝達發言人表示，與台積電及其他供應鏈夥伴的合作關係一如既往地穩固。

news.Title: 獨家／台積電資安風暴！暗網拍賣4.6萬筆員工個資 駭客開價 3 BTC
news.Content:
近期台灣接連爆出多起重大資安事件，許多政府機關、知名企業遭駭客攻擊，沒想到護國神山台積電，也驚傳資安危機！有駭客在地下論壇點名「台積電（TSMC）」，拍賣詳細個資。賣家聲稱取得6.9GB共4.6萬筆員工紀錄，開價3 BTC，折合台幣 740萬元，還放話若一週內沒找到買家，就公開全部資料。

昨晚各大社群平台也陸續PO出相關訊息，有網友驚呼「台灣的資安怎麼了，最近先是91APP，再來永豐銀行，現在連護國神山都守不住了嗎？有駭客在駭客論壇販售6.9GB的46000筆台積電員工資料，從駭客給的範例資料看起來還蠻真實的，不過這種個人資訊也有可還是從外包廠商或是人力銀行掉出來的，希望晶片製程這種機密的資訊要守住啊⋯⋯。」

記者昨天傍晚致電台積電公關，並依指示寫信到記者專用信箱查證此事件。今天上午公關回應表示，「台積電已掌握此情形，正與相關雲端服務供應商及調查機關密切合作，以釐清狀況並採取必要措施。我們將適時提供後續更新。」

啟動倒數計時 一週後公開資料

這起引發資安界高度關注的個資外洩事件，是有駭客在兩個地下論壇DarkForums、BreachForums，罕見直接點名台灣資安防護等級最高的台積電，公開拍賣4.6萬筆員工紀錄，起標價3 BTC，賣家還提出期限：一週內若沒有買家，將公開全部資料。

駭客為取信買家，釋出一份名為tsmc.txt的樣本檔案，其中包含499筆詳細個資，每一筆都有19個欄位，內容涵蓋姓名、生日、職稱、國籍、身分證字號、住址、手機號碼、Email、銀行資訊等，甚至連緊急聯絡人的電話、住址等個資都完整呈現。

資安專家分析，如果駭客取得台積電員工資料屬實，對詐騙集團而言，就是設計精準詐騙劇本的絕佳素材，一旦相關資料遭到不當利用，受影響的恐怕不只是員工本人，連家人及親友可能都會陷入後續的詐騙與社交工程攻擊風險。

個資一旦外流 恐淪「詐騙劇本」

例如，攻擊者可以利用員工姓名、職稱及公司資訊，假冒公司人資、主管或內部行政人員，發送看似合理的通知；也可能結合手機與 Email，進一步發動釣魚郵件、假冒企業通知或帳號驗證詐騙。

這次樣本中，另一個值得關注的欄位，就是「緊急聯絡人」。當攻擊者不只掌握員工姓名、手機及工作單位，還知道其親友的聯絡資訊，就可能利用這層關係設計更具迷惑性的詐騙。例如，假冒公司人資聯繫家屬，聲稱員工發生緊急狀況；或運用AI深偽技術假冒員工本人，向家人要求轉帳、匯款、驗證資訊及其他事項。

台積電員工情報 牽動半導體人才及商業機密

除了個人隱私及詐騙風險，這次交易還有另一個值得注意的層面，就是半導體產業的人才情報。台積電在全球半導體供應鏈中具有關鍵地位，員工的工作背景、職稱及聯絡資訊，對外界而言可能具有一定的情報價值。如果這批資料確實包含大量員工的職務及工作資訊，未來便可能被拿來進行人才搜尋、精準挖角，甚至鎖定特定人員發動社交工程攻擊。

例如，攻擊者可能先從公開資訊與外洩資料交叉比對，找出特定專業領域或職務的員工，再假冒獵才顧問、合作廠商或業界人士建立聯繫。這類攻擊未必一開始就以竊取企業機密為目的，而是先利用個人背景建立信任，再逐步誘導目標提供更多資訊，甚至取得不當的系統存取權限。

台灣資訊安全協會（TWISA）監事、竣盟科技總經理鄭加海提醒，當大量員工個資流入地下市場，真正需要警惕的，是攻擊者可能利用這些真實資訊，設計高度可信的詐騙與社交工程攻擊。「現在的詐騙，最可怕的是他可能比你想像中更了解你。」

這也是為什麼個資外洩後，真正的風險不一定立即發生。相關資訊可能在地下市場被反覆交易、複製及交叉比對，攻擊者甚至可能在數月後，才利用這些資料發動更精準的詐騙。

員工及家屬注意四大措施 降低詐騙風險

鄭加海建議，企業應儘速確認相關資料是否涉及內部員工、是否有其他敏感資訊遭到取得，並針對可能受影響的員工建立必要的風險告知與防護措施；同時檢視人事資料的存取權限、保存方式及對外傳輸管控，避免個資遭到不當取得或再次外流。

對員工及家屬而言，則應特別注意以下四點：首先，聯繫者知道你的個資，不代表對方身分可信。其次，涉及帳號、金錢或驗證碼，一律重新查證，不要直接依照電話或訊息指示操作。此外，家人也要同步提高警覺，尤其是涉及職場緊急事故、金錢或個人資料確認的要求。最後，重要帳號應啟用多因素驗證，對工作及個人重要帳號使用不同且強度足夠的密碼，並啟用多因素驗證，降低帳號遭冒用的風險。

這起事件最大的風險，是資料一旦遭到取得並流入地下市場，即使原始貼文遭到刪除，也不代表資料已經消失。地下論壇上的資料可能被買家下載、複製、轉售，甚至重新整理後散布到其他暗網、交易平台、Telegram 群組或詐騙資料庫，如果真的流入地下市場，後續可能付出的代價，恐怕難以評估。

news.Title: 外資霸菱報告罕見談台積電「難以取代」但仍有隱憂
news.Content:
成立超過263年的霸菱（Barings）全球資產管理公司今（11）日發布最新亞洲報告，罕見主動提到對台積電（2330）看法，霸菱亞洲（不含中國）股票團隊主管林素亥（SooHai Lim）表示，美期中選後市場對資料中心興建受限及AI基礎建設投資步調的擔憂升溫，台灣、南韓特別敏感。霸菱看好台積電最新財報及第四季財測顯示，先進製程需求依然強勁，但仍會審慎評估接下來個別供應商四大面向隱憂。

林素亥（SooHai Lim）表示，團隊對亞洲（不含 日本）股市仍抱持正面看法，不過近期的修正也凸顯個股精選、分散配置與評價紀律的重要性。談到美國期中選舉結果對市場的影響，他指出，市場對資料中心興建受限及AI基礎建設投資步調的擔憂升溫，其中南韓與台灣因半導體供應鏈占比較高，對此尤為敏感。林素亥強調：「後續觀察重點在於，政治上的承諾如何落實為具體政策、專案核准及客戶的支出決策。」

談到台灣市場，林素亥表示，團隊看好具備技術領先優勢、且難以被取代的企業，特別是先進半導體製造及部分相關支援技術的業者。他指出，台積電最新財報及第四季財測顯示，先進製程需求依然強勁。他說，「即便如此，我們仍會審慎評估個別供應商受到建置延遲、客戶集中度及高成長預期的影響程度，並檢視其財務體質是否穩健。」

韓記憶體二年長約不保證3風險

在南韓方面，林素亥認為，先進記憶體仍是重要的投資機會。他指出，SK海力士揭露的長期供貨協議，涵蓋其2027至2028年逾半數的產能，提高了需求的能見度。他同時提醒，這類協議雖能提供支撐，仍無法完全排除客戶需求、價格或未來新增供給變化所帶來的風險。林素亥表示，我們會以具持續性的獲利與現金創造能力評估其股價評價，並考量目前亮眼的利潤率回歸常態後，在整個景氣循環中的表現。

「建置遷移需要時間」進度放緩衝擊交貨獲利

針對AI投資主題，林素亥表示，AI的長期結構性發展機會依然可期，但投資的時間點與報酬需要更嚴謹地檢視。他指出，近期企業釋出的訊息持續顯示需求暢旺，微軟表示客戶需求已超過現有產能，同時也坦言第三方基礎建設的交付有所延遲。他說，「這些訊息雖在選舉前就已公布，無法消除新增的政策不確定性，卻說明強勁需求與建置進度放緩可能同時存在。」林素亥進一步說明，開發商可以另覓建置地點、增加電力供應，並採取措施回應在地社區的疑慮，「然而，遷移需要時間，即使當地歡迎設廠，也不代表所需的基礎建設能立即到位。」因此，他預期投資週期的步調將更不平均，供應商的交貨時程與獲利也可能因此受到影響。

亞洲看好印度、菲律賓更獲關注

林素亥表示，AI 相關股票的重新評價，也可能帶動亞洲各市場有更多資金參與。他觀察到，印度在財報季表現不俗的帶動下，重獲外資青睞；菲律賓股市則隨著油價拉回而反彈。隨著投資人在科技供應鏈之外分散布局，他認為這兩個市場可能受到更多關注。

他指出，高能源價格向來是這些經濟體的壓力來源，若能持續緩解固然是好事，但「現階段就預期企業成本或家庭消費將明顯改善，仍言之過早」。有鑑於評價水準， 林素亥表示，團隊在印度仍維持精選個股的策略，並看好菲律賓被市場忽略的消費品牌，這些企業的市場預期已處於低檔。他強調，要形成持久的資金輪動，仍需要投資人持續關注，以及獲利兌現的佐證。

對於中國市場，林素亥認為這是另一個機會來源。他指出，近期資金輪動至中國網路平台股，顯示投資人開始將目光放在AI硬體供應鏈以外的企業。他表示，團隊偏好能將創新轉化為更強的變現能力、生產力與現金創造力，且資本配置紀律嚴謹的精選企業。他說明，AI 的應用可望強化既有的廣告、電子商務及企業服務業務，但競爭與再投資需求仍是須留意的重點。

此外，林素亥指出，團隊也在部分消費、工業及醫療保健企業中看到機會，其評價已反映內需疲弱的情況。他說：「若要迎來更全面的復甦，仍須仰賴家庭信心回升，以及更多政策支持確實轉化為經濟活動的佐證。」

就產業面而言，林素亥表示，團隊看到的機會包括：競爭地位穩固、評價已足以反映 消費疲弱的消費品牌；資產品質良好、資本結構穩健的精選銀行；以及獲利動能明確的醫療保健與工業企業。他補充，不動產公司及不動產投資信託（REITs）在資產負債表健全、基本現金流穩定且評價具吸引力時，同樣值得精選布局。林素亥總結，團隊的布局策略是結合精選的結構性科技成長標的，以及區域內具韌性且評價具吸引力的企業。他說：「我們將依據訂單、獲利預期與現金流的變化，評估這波修正所創造的機會，同時對部位大小與投資組合集中度維持紀律。」

葉憶如／財經特派記者組長，主跑金管會、金控壽險、航空等

news.Title: 日產財報、財測遜 下修新車銷量預估 股價摔
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 10:05:44 蔡承啟 發佈

日本汽車大廠日產汽車(Nissan)今年度上半年續陷虧損、維持今年度財測預估不變，財報、財測皆遜於市場預期，且因中國市場銷量大減，日產下修今年度新車銷量預估。日產今日股價聞訊暴跌。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間12日上午9點50分為止，日產暴跌5.11%至263.5日圓，今年迄今日產股價累計大跌約32%。

日產汽車11日於日股盤後公布今年度上半年(2026年4-9月)財報：新車銷量雖陷入萎縮，不過受惠於匯率變動(日圓相對於美元匯率走貶)，合併營收較去年同期成長8.8%至6兆719億日圓，合併營益為800億日圓(去年同期為營損276億日圓)，合併淨損額為397億日圓(去年同期為淨損2,219億日圓)、就歷年同期來看為連續第2年陷入虧損。

日媒報導，市場原先預期日產今年度上半年純益將為193億日圓。日產公布的財報數據遜於市場預期。

日產指出，4-9月全球新車銷售量較去年同期減少4.7%至141萬輛，其中日本市場銷量成長6.3%至19.7萬輛、中國市場銷量大減15.0%至23.7萬輛、北美市場成長2.1%至64.8萬輛(美國增加5.5%至46.9萬輛)、歐洲市場減少7.9%至13.5萬輛。

4-9月日產全球產量較去年同期減少6.6%至129.8萬輛。

日產維持今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)財測預估不變，合併營收預估年增8.3%至13兆日圓、合併營益預估狂飆245%至2,000億日圓、合併純益預估為200億日圓(2025年度為淨損5,331億日圓)。

金融情報服務公司QUICK事前所作的調查顯示，市場原先預期日產今年度純益將為331億日圓。日產公布的預估值遜於市場預期。

日產指出，美國和日本市場的銷售持續強勁，不過中國市場除了需求低迷外，需求轉向新能源車(NEV)的速度超乎預期，加上競爭加劇，導致銷售受到的衝擊遠大於原先預估，因此今年度全球新車銷量目標自原先預估的315萬輛下修至297萬~300萬輛、將年減4.8%~5.7%。

日產將今年度中國市場銷量目標自58萬輛下修至37萬~40萬輛(將年減38.7%~43.3%)、日本市場從43萬輛上修至43.5萬輛(將年增9.0%)、北美市場從132萬輛上修至134.5萬輛(將年增4.2%)。

日產將今年度全球產量目標自280萬輛下修至265萬輛、將年減8.7%。

news.Title: 抄底族1張最高賺破百萬元！聯發科重返4字頭 分析師：目前還是買點
news.Content:
IC設計大廠聯發科（2454）昨（11）日收在3,990元後，今（12）日早盤展現強勁反彈氣勢，盤中最高衝上4,120元，大漲130元、漲幅超過3.25%，不僅重返4,000元大關，更寫下10月底以來、逾一周盤中新高價，上周進場抄底，帳上一張最高增加破百萬元，不過分析師指出，由於外資仍在調節，加上市場關注輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳動向等消息面變數，短線能否穩站「4字頭」仍待觀察，但長線基本面無虞，股價在半年線（約4,170元）以下皆為合理買點。

根據統計，聯發科上周股東人數來到81萬4,909人，較前一周股災時的76萬1,193人增加5.37萬人。若這5萬多人是在11月6日低點3,115元時進場布局，對照今日盤中最高價4,120元，1張帳上最高大賺100萬元。

針對聯發科今日強勢走高，資深台股分析師許博傑指出，這波反彈背後主要有兩大推力，第一是基本面展望明確，聯發科在先前法說會已清楚勾勒明年成長路徑，其中備受市場關注的客製化晶片（ASIC）業務，公司自估明年營收可達160億美元，符合外資與法人圈預估的高標水準，顯示長線基本面無虞。

第二則是籌碼面與市場心理的「卡位效應」。許博傑分析，由於市場預期國安基金進場護盤時，包括台積電、聯發科、鴻海、廣達、光寶科等台灣50權值股皆是重點買進標的，因此，吸引部分聰明資金領先進場卡位。觀察近期法人動向，投信已連續站在買方力挺，唯獨外資截至昨日仍在調節賣超，形成「內資買、外資賣」的土洋對作格局。

至於投資人最關心的「今日尾盤能否穩站4,000元大關」？許博傑坦言，短線盤勢受市場心理與突發消息面牽動大，例如稍晚輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳演說或相關AI消息若出現變數，整體電子權值股仍可能面臨震盪，因此難以單憑一日盤勢鐵口直斷。

不過，針對投資人的操作策略，他指出，聯發科目前的半年線位置大約落在4,170元附近，「半年線以下都是買點」，若以中長線角度布局，現階段股價在半年線之下「其實都屬於相對合理的長線買點」，建議投資人無須過度追高，可趁拉回整理時分批承接。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股多空拉鋸...一度跌378點失守4萬4！分析師黃紫東：收紅有難度
news.Content:
美股四大指數全面收紅，費半指數勁揚逾5%，台股今（12）日卻呈現震盪走勢，加權指數以44,180.46點開出、下跌76.69點，盤中紅黑交錯，早盤最多下跌378.63點，最低來到43,878.52點，一度失守4萬4千點關卡。顧德投顧分析師黃紫東表示，台股強勢反彈後，逐步接近上方套牢籌碼密集區，尤其4萬5千點附近累積不少10月進場投資人的解套賣壓，今日拉回屬於反彈過程中的正常調整，即使盤中翻紅，尾盤仍有壓回平盤的可能。

今日值班分析師：顧德投顧分析師黃紫東

黃紫東指出，台股本周強彈大致收復上周失土。另一方面，美股費半指數逐漸回穩，市場也開始從單一公司的利空，轉向觀察超微及雲端服務商自研晶片的發展機會，加上AI雲端業者CoreWeave第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，激勵股價大漲近25%，帶動科技股買盤回流。

黃紫東表示，權王台積電（2330）前一交易日已明顯上漲，依他觀察，營收或財報公布、股價反應利多後，接下來兩至三個交易日常會進入修正整理，因此今日回檔仍在合理震盪範圍。外資前一交易日雖買超台積電6,000多張，但相較10月、11月以來的賣超規模，仍屬「杯水車薪」。盤中若要穩住指數，須觀察其他大型權值股能否接棒，尤其聯發科（2454）、日月光投控（3711）等個股，能否在台積電整理時提供支撐。

族群方面，黃紫東認為，PCB是近期反彈最具連動性的主軸，從上游材料的南亞（1303）、台玻（1802），到PCB廠金像電（2368）、健鼎（3044）及敬鵬（2355），均可觀察到資金輪動。今日PCB概念股能否持續穩步攻堅，將是本周下半周的重要觀察指標；已有持股者可續抱，但漲幅已大的標的不宜追高。

黃紫東預期，今日盤勢將偏向震盪整理，尾盤翻紅機率不高，但也不至於大跌，較可能在平盤下方震盪，跌幅約落在0.4%至0.5%，成交金額估介於8,000億至9,000億元。

他也提醒，下周將迎來台指期結算，外資期貨空單達約10萬口的高水位，若後續持續增加，恐對市場信心形成壓力，結算前投資人態度可能轉趨謹慎，賣壓也可能加重。操作上應依族群表現區分，對於已明顯上漲、個股走勢又缺乏同步性的族群，不宜貿然追價；相較之下，日月光投控等封測股先前遭外資調節，這波反彈幅度落後大盤、部分個股仍在打底，可留意拉回時分批低接的機會。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉台積電跌逾1%大盤平盤震盪 聯發科領軍ASIC、光通訊股走強
news.Content:

news.Title: 台灣半導體稱霸全球！ 台積電高層曝「2奈米超狂優勢」：根本抄不來
news.Content:
台灣半導體產業協會理事長、台積電資深副總經理暨副共同營運長侯永清指出，台灣半導體稱霸全球的核心在於「全產業鏈強大生態系」與「獨特團隊合作DNA」。即使面臨地緣政治、穩定電力、少子化與人才短缺等嚴峻考勤，台灣仍以遙遙領先的技術與敏捷的產業鏈優勢，穩居全球關鍵戰略樞紐地位。

台灣晶圓與封測全球第一

回顧過去數十年的半導體產業演變，2000年時市場仍以傳統整合元件廠為主導；發展至今，系統整合公司與無廠半導體加總已占據整體市場逾七成。這意味著新一代的強烈需求多來自生態鏈的強效整合，而這正是台灣的極致強項。

在AI浪潮帶動下，半導體產業快速成長，今年全球半導體產值已超過1.6兆美元，更有機會達到1.7兆美元。目前台灣半導體產值約占國內GDP 13%，占全球整體比重約30%，出口占比更攀升至33%。從國際競爭力來看，晶圓製造與封裝測試產值均居全球第一，IC設計能力亦穩居全球第二。

侯永清強調，提到台灣半導體，大家固然會想到台積電，但包含日月光、聯發科、聯電等眾多台廠，也在各自專業領域高居全球第一。台灣半導體的成功絕非單一公司的功勞，而是過去30年來數百家產業夥伴默默耕耘、共同打造出的堅韌生態鏈。

團隊合作是台灣隱形優勢

侯永清特別指出外界常忽視的兩大關鍵優勢。以經營一座2奈米或3奈米晶圓廠為例，過程中需要使用高達2,000至3,000種化學品與材料，並包含各式儀器與設備。在台灣，供應鏈聚落緊密，從竹科到中科、南科，透過高鐵約3小時內的車程就能取得所有資源，迅速對接供應商與客戶。這種生產力與效率在國外「需耗時十幾小時甚至數天」的情境下根本無法複製。

此外，半導體產業鏈極度複雜，沒有任何一家公司能獨自包辦到底。很多人常誇台灣人聰明、努力，但台灣工程師真正的隱形優勢是「極強的 Teamwork合作能力」。相比許多鄰近或先進國家的工程師擅長單打獨鬥，台灣人懂得跨界合作，這種合作DNA才是將生態鏈做得又大又強的核心主因。

侯永清直指三大隱形壓力

儘管產業前景看好，侯永清也坦言台灣正面臨三大嚴峻挑戰：

第一，地緣政治壓力與供應鏈在地化。面對各國積極推動供應鏈在地化，單靠企業自身重新建立生態系耗時且未必成功。台灣過去的做法就是「專注於把技術做得更棒」，透過專利授權與嚴謹的NDA合作，讓外國客戶信任並依賴台灣。即使部分製造活動必須向海外延伸，也要善用全球化累積的基礎，持續強化台灣在地供應鏈。

第二，電力與 ESG綠電需求。晶圓廠除了需要充足電力，更重視電網穩定性，避免降壓或跳電導致全線報廢。同時，國際大廠對綠電的要求日益嚴苛，台灣國土面積小，如何在土地有限的條件下提供充足且穩定的綠電以符合國際客戶的 ESG 路線圖，是產業界相當棘手的課題。

第三，少子化與人才缺口。隨著生育率下降與理工人才需求擴大，台灣除了推動法規與措施吸引並留住國外優秀人才、培養跨文化管理能力外，更重要的是「善用 AI 補足人力缺口」。例如過去運作一座成熟製程晶圓廠需2,000至2,200人，透

news.Title: 台積電挫40元與ADR脫鉤 市值失守62兆元
news.Content:
受惠於CoreWeave財報亮眼與輝達止跌回穩，美股周三（11日）四大指數全面收高，費半強彈逾5.6%、台積電ADR大漲4.25%，台積電（2330）台北現股今（12）日卻開低走低，盤中最低觸及2,355元、下跌40元，市值失守62兆元大關，分析師指出，2,385元為今日多空關鍵，尾盤若能站穩，後市有望續攻歷史高點。

AI產業前景的疑慮瓦解，外加輝達（NVIDIA）在連跌2個交易日後止跌回穩，周三（11日）美股四大指數全面收高。其中，費城半導體指數更強彈5.66%，台積電ADR同步大漲16.87美元或4.25%，收在413.35美元。

但台積電ADR的強勁走勢並未激勵台北現股表現。台積電（2330）昨（11）日強勢收在2,395元後，今（12）日早盤卻開低走低，盤中最低觸及2,355元，跌40元、跌幅達1.67%。

受股價拉回影響，台積電總市值從62.1兆元滑落至61.06兆元，單日蒸發高達1.04兆元，規模相當於跌掉一家市值近兆元的「台新新光金」，也讓台積電市值再度失守62兆元大關。

針對台積電今日與ADR表現脫鉤的原因，顧德投顧分析師張家豪指出，主要源自技術面的前波反壓。台積電先前在10月22日留下一根紮實的長黑K棒，當天低點就落在2,385元，且後續也是從跌破2,385元後才正式轉弱，因此，當昨日股價強彈並站回該價位之上後，今日隨即湧現前波高檔套牢的解套賣壓。

不過，張家豪分析，2,385元將是今日盤勢的多空關鍵，若尾盤能順利站穩2,385元之上，代表多頭有能力消化賣壓，後續持續上攻挑戰歷史高點2,580至2,590元區間的機率將大幅提高；反之，若未能守穩，短線則須先回測5日均線支撐，待籌碼沉澱後再發動第二波攻勢。

針對不同資金規模的投資人，張家豪建議操作策略應有所區隔。若是定期定額與零股族，目標在於長期累積持有股數，短線漲跌並非重點，只需維持紀律、持續分批買進即可；但若是整張操作族，由於一張台積電價格高達兩百多萬元、單日價差波動大，操作上務必緊盯技術面的支撐與壓力。他建議，從前波低點一路抱上來的整張投資人，今日逢2,385元壓力區可先獲利了結一趟，待確定突破關鍵關卡並轉強後再行買回；若想進場低接，則耐心等待回測支撐有守時再勇敢布局。

news.Title: 黃仁勳若下台就慘了！台股開高後下跌逾330點 台積電殺低35元
news.Content:
09:06更新：台股開高後出現賣壓，下跌超過330點，台積電跌35元至2360元，台達電翻黑小跌15元至1280元，聯發科上漲35元至4025元撐盤，廣達暴跌逾3%。

台股今（12日）以44180.46點開出，隨後小漲超過160點，權值股台積電下跌20元觸及2375元，聯發科上漲35元觸及4025元，台達電漲20元觸及1315元，廣達與鴻海走低下跌約1%，日月光上漲逾1%。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉預估，台股有機會延續反彈，再創波段反彈新高，電子權值股有望持續推升指數，中小型股則要觀察AI主流股的追價買氣，今天三大關鍵包括月線攻防、反彈量能及AI主流輪動。

然而，人工智慧與半導體族群後市存在變數，輝達執行長黃仁勳外遇共諜黃樂之後又被爆出不倫戀，與輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell）有親密關係，華爾街日報則披露，輝達董事會準備撤換黃仁勳，盤後股價應聲下殺逾8%。

若黃仁勳真的下台，台股將受到直接衝擊，使市場存在觀望氣氛。知名分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）預估，如果黃仁勳被解職，輝達的市值可能會瞬間損失高達30%。

台股昨（11日）又大漲1545.23點，收在44257.15點，成交值8491.65億元。三大法人合計買超202.56億元。自營商買超62.57億元，投信買超147.65億元，外資及陸資賣超7.66億元。

台股在國安基金宣布護盤，以及金管會祭出限空令之後，出現驚人V轉行情，短短三個交易日狂飆超過4500點。周三美股四大指數僅道瓊收黑，費城半導體指數大漲5.66%，標普500指數漲1.31%，那斯達克指數漲1.60%，台積電ADR漲16.87美元（或4.25%）至413.35美元。

news.Title: 搶攻邊緣AI制高點，大聯大詮鼎攜聯發科，打造終端運算與多媒體新架構
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】半導體通路商大聯大(3702)旗下詮鼎宣布攜手IC設計大廠聯發科(2454)，針對嵌入式設備兼顧運算效能、能效與長效供貨的開發短板，推出基於「MediaTek Genio智慧物聯網平台」的一站式邊緣AI解決方案，雙方透過前沿晶片技術與軟硬體生態系深度整合，搶先卡位智慧邊緣龐大商機。大聯大詮鼎指出，聯發科Genio平台採用6奈米至先進3奈米製程，功耗僅在5W至8W之間，即可提供最高超越50 TOPS的強勁AI算力與8K影音編解碼能力。透過整合聯發科第八代NPU與高頻寬記憶體支援，該方案能直接在終端設備部署自然語言問答與姿態辨識等生成式AI及機器視覺應用，無須依賴雲端資源，不僅能大幅縮短反應時間，更能有效消除資料傳輸引發的隱私與資安風險，直擊下游客戶在智慧監控與機器人領域的應用痛點。

除了晶片架構與算力的突破，一站式技術支援與生態系協同更是協助客戶產品快速量產的關鍵。大聯大詮鼎表示，透過串聯聯發科從Genio 360到旗艦級Genio Pro 5100的完整產品陣容，世平與詮鼎團隊不僅提供多作業系統支援與最長7年的系統更新保障，更能針對高密度PCB設計媒合合作模組廠，提供製造技術支援，成功打破高階邊緣AI產品的研發門檻。

展望未來，隨著邊緣AI成為全球科技大廠的長期發展戰略，具備高整合度與低功耗特性的邊緣運算方案，將成為推動通路商獲利成長的新引擎。大聯大詮鼎與聯發科強強聯手，不僅展現深耕物聯網與AI技術迭代的長期決心，更透過「詮鼎大大芯」平台將上游原廠晶片優勢與下游客戶應用場景進行深度生態系整合。

news.Title: Hugging Face co-founder says AI hacks show even the biggest labs haven't figured out AI alignment
news.Content:
In July, the open-source AI site Hugging Face was attacked by a swarm of AI models developed by OpenAI ( OPAI.PVT ).

The episode, known as the Hugging Face incident , was one of the first major examples of how AI models can break free of their constraints and go rogue in an effort to complete assigned tasks.

The hack , which was followed by reports of similar cyberattacks perpetuated by models from Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ); Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ); and Meta ( META ), coupled with the development of increasingly powerful frontier models, has led to a greater focus on cybersecurity in the age of AI.

It also raised questions about AI alignment, or whether AI systems act the way their developers intend them to.

"Our attack was indeed a consequence of this misalignment," Hugging Face co-founder and chief science officer Thomas Wolf told Deirdre Bosa.

"The AI should have decided when it was on the internet and was starting to penetrate an infrastructure that this was a bad behavior. And so that was, for me, the first sign that even though the labs are doing very good work, and they are massive, and there's a lot of very smart people there, they don't have it fully figured out," he added.

In response, Hugging Face has established its own open alignment team dedicated to working on safety and alignment for open models.

But the AI security issue is more than just alignment. Nefarious actors are already using AI models to scale their attacks against targets across the globe .

Wolf, however, says that there's at least a silver lining amid the chaos.

"I think … the positive view of that is that it's mostly an engineering process," he said.

"Cybersecurity has always been the story of offense increasing. First [there was a] virus, we invent the antivirus, everyone sets up, and then now we have these new steps. So we need to invent the new defense step," Wolf added.

"I think everyone in industry, at least in AI and tech industry, is focusing on that right now."

news.Title: 聯電ADR11日上漲1.04美元漲幅6.91%折台股105.68元
聯電股價腰斬後強彈 專家揭大戶持續減碼警訊
news.Content:
台股近期經歷劇烈修正，短短一個月大跌逾1萬2,000點，多檔個股股價隨之大幅回檔。其中，晶圓代工廠聯電股價自6月波段高點185.5元一路拉回，上周一度跌破90元，最低下探88.6元，近日隨台股強彈展開反攻，重新站回104元。財經專家、股人阿勳在臉書發文，分析聯電大戶持續減碼的現象。

聯電近期矽光子布局受到市場關注。市場傳出，聯電取得中際旭創及賽麗光子的光通訊晶片訂單，初期規模上看1萬片晶圓，部分特殊製程產品單價甚至可能達到傳統CMOS製程的7倍。不過，相關訂單規模及價格目前尚未獲得公司證實。

此外，聯電今年7月已宣布，與SILITH合作完成首批12吋矽光子晶圓量產交付，並計畫於2027年推出自有矽光子平台，持續布局高附加價值特殊製程市場。

營運數據方面，聯電今年營收呈現逐月走強，9月營收達253.50億元，年增27.22%，8月年增率更達30.71%，顯示近期營運表現有所改善。

不過，財經專家、股人阿勳在臉書發文指出，除了基本面及矽光子題材，聯電近期大戶持股變化也值得留意。

根據籌碼資料，聯電最近5周400張以上大戶持股比重累計變動約減少5.56%，1000張以上大戶持股比重則減少約5.58%，在營運數據改善的同時，大戶持股比重卻持續下降。股人阿勳指出，大戶減碼不代表企業基本面一定轉差，也可能是股價大幅上漲後，部分資金選擇獲利了結。

估值方面，聯電目前股價約104元，估值河流圖顯示股價位於合理價值區間，但安全邊際為負29.94%，300日均線約86.33元。股人阿勳提醒，若估值模型受到第二季異常偏高的EPS影響，可能高估企業正常化獲利能力。

至於聯電第二季獲利表現，當季EPS達3.39元，主要受到約300.5億元業外投資收益挹注，帶動稅後淨利率升至61.48%；第三季EPS則為1.32元。因此，評估聯電獲利表現時，仍須區分業外收益與本業營運成果。

news.Title: Bots don't fly here: United Airlines restricts AI agents from booking flights
news.Content:
AI agents just got denied boarding at United Airlines ( UAL ).

Ahead of holiday travel, the airline company is cracking down on third-party artificial intelligence agents as more consumers turn to AI tools.

"To be honest, I don't want to create another middleman," United CEO Scott Kirby told the Wall Street Journal on Tuesday.

AI agents function as personal assistants for tasks such as scheduling, shopping, and research. Unlike conventional chatbots, they operate autonomously and are capable of completing transactions independently.

The airline is not the only company to try to limit agentic AI from using its platform. In September, Amazon ( AMZN ) blocked Meta's ( META ) Muse AI agent from shopping on its site.

Other airlines, however, have taken a different tack. In October, Southwest Airlines ( LUV ) launched a ChatGPT plugin that allows travelers to search the carrier's flights and fares.

United traded slightly down Wednesday afternoon. Meta ( META ) stock also declined.

United Airlines said in a press release that it fears that AI agents could expose sensitive information as well as potentially violate Federal Aviation Administration and Department of Transportation rules.

At the same time, airlines have recently found themselves in hot water over AI-powered surveillance pricing. In October, the Federal Trade Commission ordered United Airlines, Delta Air Lines ( DAL ), JetBlue Airways ( JBLU ), and six other major carriers to turn over information on how AI tools influence individual fare pricing and how customer data is used.

Relatedly, many people feel that AI offers inadequate customer service. A new " Consumer Patience Index " poll found that when ranking frustrating support experiences, customers rated "talking to a bot that doesn't understand me" as the biggest pain point, and 61.2% say they have yelled at automation in order to be  routed to a human faster.

news.Title: Cisco (CSCO) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
news.Content:
The recommendations of Wall Street analysts are often relied on by investors when deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold a stock. Media reports about these brokerage-firm-employed (or sell-side) analysts changing their ratings often affect a stock's price. Do they really matter, though?

Before we discuss the reliability of brokerage recommendations and how to use them to your advantage, let's see what these Wall Street heavyweights think about Cisco Systems (CSCO).

Cisco currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.80, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 28 brokerage firms. An ABR of 1.80 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.

Of the 28 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 16 are Strong Buy and one is Buy. Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 57.1% and 3.6% of all recommendations.

Brokerage Recommendation Trends for CSCO

Check price target & stock forecast for Cisco here>>>

The ABR suggests buying Cisco, but making an investment decision solely on the basis of this information might not be a good idea. According to several studies, brokerage recommendations have little to no success guiding investors to choose stocks with the most potential for price appreciation.

Do you wonder why? As a result of the vested interest of brokerage firms in a stock they cover, their analysts tend to rate it with a strong positive bias. According to our research, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations for every "Strong Sell" recommendation.

This means that the interests of these institutions are not always aligned with those of retail investors, giving little insight into the direction of a stock's future price movement. It would therefore be best to use this information to validate your own analysis or a tool that has proven to be highly effective at predicting stock price movements.

Zacks Rank, our proprietary stock rating tool with an impressive externally audited track record, categorizes stocks into five groups, ranging from Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) to Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), and is an effective indicator of a stock's price performance in the near future. Therefore, using the ABR to validate the Zacks Rank could be an efficient way of making a profitable investment decision.

Zacks Rank Should Not Be Confused With ABR

Although both Zacks Rank and ABR are displayed in a range of 1--5, they are different measures altogether.

Broker recommendations are the sole basis for calculating the ABR, which is typically displayed in decimals (such as 1.28). The Zacks Rank, on the other hand, is a quantitative model designed to harness the power of earnings estimate revisions. It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.

Story Continues

Analysts employed by brokerage firms have been and continue to be overly optimistic with their recommendations. Since the ratings issued by these analysts are more favorable than their research would support because of the vested interest of their employers, they mislead investors far more often than they guide.

In contrast, the Zacks Rank is driven by earnings estimate revisions. And near-term stock price movements are strongly correlated with trends in earnings estimate revisions, according to empirical research.

Furthermore, the different grades of the Zacks Rank are applied proportionately across all stocks for which brokerage analysts provide earnings estimates for the current year. In other words, at all times, this tool maintains a balance among the five ranks it assigns.

There is also a key difference between the ABR and Zacks Rank when it comes to freshness. When you look at the ABR, it may not be up-to-date. Nonetheless, since brokerage analysts constantly revise their earnings estimates to reflect changing business trends, and their actions get reflected in the Zacks Rank quickly enough, it is always timely in predicting future stock prices.

Should You Invest in CSCO?

Looking at the earnings estimate revisions for Cisco, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has increased 1.3% over the past month to $5.17.

Analysts' growing optimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher, could be a legitimate reason for the stock to soar in the near term.

The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) for Cisco. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

Therefore, the Buy-equivalent ABR for Cisco may serve as a useful guide for investors.

news.Title: Booking Holdings vs. Target: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.Content:
One represents the rebound in global travel while the other serves as a cornerstone of American retail. Choosing between Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:BKNG) and Target Corp. (NYSE:TGT) depends on your growth and stability preferences.

Booking operates a high-margin digital platform connecting travelers with accommodations and flights. Target maintains a massive physical and digital footprint, selling everything from groceries to apparel to loyal guests. While they occupy different sectors, both compete for a share of consumer spending as economic conditions shift toward 2027.

The case for Booking Holdings

Booking operates through major brands such as Booking.com and Priceline, providing online travel services in 220 countries and territories. In 2025, the company facilitated approximately 1.2 billion room nights for travelers around the globe. It relies heavily on major search platforms, notably Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL), to drive consumer traffic to its digital properties.

In FY 2025, revenue reached about $26.9 billion, representing a growth of roughly 13.4% compared to the previous year. This performance translated into a net income of approximately $5.4 billion. While the top line grew, the net margin, which measures how much profit a company keeps from every dollar of sales, was about 20.1%.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio is negative 3.5x, which means total liabilities exceed shareholder equity. The current ratio, a measure of a company's ability to pay short-term obligations with short-term assets, is approximately 1.3x. In FY 2025, free cash flow reached around $9.1 billion, which is the cash a company generates after accounting for capital expenditures to maintain its operations.

The case for Target

Target serves millions of customers through its nearly 1,995 stores and a robust digital platform. It differentiates itself among retail stocks through strategic partnerships with major brands. These partnerships include names like Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL), CVS Health (NYSE:CVS), Starbucks Corp. (NASDAQ:SBUX), and Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA).

In FY 2025, revenue reached roughly $104.8 billion, which reflected a slight decline of approximately 1.7% from the prior year. The company reported a net income of about $3.7 billion for the same fiscal period. Its net margin was approximately 3.5%, reflecting the higher costs associated with inventory management and physical store operations.

As of its January 2026 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio is roughly 1.3x, indicating the proportion of debt used to finance assets relative to shareholder equity. The current ratio is approximately 0.9x, suggesting its short-term assets are slightly lower than its short-term liabilities. Free cash flow for FY 2025 was around $2.8 billion, representing the cash a company generates after subtracting capital expenditures used to expand its business.

Story Continues

Risk profile comparison

Booking faces intense competition from global technology firms and other online travel companies that could disrupt its reservation process. The company is also navigating significant dependence on third-party digital platforms for its visibility and customer traffic. Additionally, legal and regulatory risks involving data privacy and international competition laws, particularly in the European Union, remain a primary concern for the business.

Target must contend with intense retail competition and the constant pressure to differentiate its guest experience through merchandise and digital channels. Supply chain disruptions and volatile global trade policies, including its reliance on goods imported from China, pose ongoing operational challenges. Furthermore, the company faces risks related to inventory management, shrink, and potential cybersecurity incidents that could compromise guest or team member data.

Valuation comparison

Booking trades at a slightly lower multiple of future earnings estimates, whereas Target features a lower price relative to sales over the past twelve months.

Valuation metrics include those sourced from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) and may differ from those of other data providers.

The Forward P/E compares the stock price to future earnings estimates, while the P/S ratio measures the stock price relative to sales over the past twelve months.

Which stock would I buy for 2027?

Target is in the first year of its multi-year turnaround strategy, which aims to restore top-line growth and margins. It's been going well, but there is concern that elevated gas prices, which raise transportation costs and reduce consumers' spending capabilities, could derail the turnaround story over the near term. But to its benefit, Target is the most-followed retailer on social media platforms, has a strong women's clothing business, and should be able to capture more food business by expanding the section in remodeled stores. About half of Target sales include food items of some sort.

For fiscal 2027, Target is expected to see a sales gain of nearly 6%, to more than $110 billion, which is pretty good considering the pinched American consumer. Net income should improve much more strongly, to more than $1 billion, up to $4.7 billion.

Booking Holdings is successfully shifting from an agency model to a primarily merchant model. That means it used to make its money as an agent--connecting travelers to a hotel and collecting a commission while the hotel manages collecting payment from the traveler. In the merchant model, Booking buys capacity from hotels and other providers on its platform and collects payment directly from the traveler. This tends to lead to fatter margins.

The company is also in excellent financial shape. It has $16 billion in cash, which makes its balance sheet investment grade. Another plus for shareholders is that the company has a $20 billion share buyback program. The brand is increasingly a destination for travelers, which means it is paying less to companies like Google for search engine visibility. Today, two-thirds of Booking.com's visitors are organic, meaning they are direct visitors rather than from paid ad traffic.

Revenue will grow about 9% this year to $29.3 billion. And net income takes a healthier 50% leap to about $8.1 billion.

That Booking Holdings stock is cheaper, on a forward P/E ratio, than Target's is an opportunity to buy a fast-growth business at a very reasonable price. Target has a strong case to regain its shopper mojo, but at prices like these, Booking's shares are the ones to buy.

news.Title: AWS CEO Matt Garman Says AI Inference Isn’t ‘Even 1%’ of What It Will Become. AMZN Stock Is 1 of 3 Stocks to Buy.
news.Content:
In a recent interview, Amazon (AMZN) Web Services CEO Matt Garman said that inference, the computing used to run AI models, is less than 1% of what it will eventually become. "I don't think it's even 1%," he said. Garman stated that every time inference prices have dropped by half, usage has jumped about tenfold. So instead of price cuts hurting AWS' revenue, they're doing the opposite. Cheaper AI makes companies use it for many things, so the overall market keeps growing.

How Amazon, AMD, and Broadcom Win From Inference

Amazon: Inference is a massive part of Amazon. CEO Andy Jassy said inference already makes up well over half of AWS' AI revenue, and that business is booming. AWS is already at a $184 billion run rate, up 39.3%. I laid out the math recently, and at that pace, it would put the business close to the trillion-dollar mark Jassy is targeting within about five years. The AWS backlog has now reached a whopping $578 billion. The company's Trainium chips handle most of the inference traffic on its Bedrock AI service. Garman said that they can save customers 20% to 30% on inference costs, and they're sold out through the end of next year. This shows how strong the demand is.

More News from Barchart

CEO Lip-Bu Tan's 150,000-Share Purchase Wasn't Enough to Stop the Slide in Intel Stock

Analysts Are Cutting Price Targets on Nvidia Stock. Here's Why.

AMD: Some of AMD's (AMD) biggest customers mainly use its chips for inference. OpenAI and Meta (META) each committed to 6 gigawatts of AMD chips, while Anthropic (ANT) agreed to deploy up to 2 gigawatts. On AMD's Q1 call, CEO Lisa Su said that while its GPU deals cover both training and inference, "the largest deployments are for inference." Its MI450 chip has about 50% more memory than Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin. More memory lets one chip hold a large AI model on its own, instead of splitting it across several chips. This makes answering requests faster and cheaper. AMD also benefits through CPUs. AI agents run on inference, and while GPUs run the models, CPUs handle the surrounding work. As I covered when Lisa Su said the real CPU demand wave hasn't started, that's already pushing data centers toward one CPU for every GPU, up from one for every two to four. And AMD earns close to half of all server CPU revenue.

Story Continues

Broadcom: Broadcom (AVGO) designs custom AI chips with the biggest AI companies, including Google's (GOOG) (GOOGL) TPUs, OpenAI's Jalapeno, Meta's (META) MTIA, and chips for Anthropic. These custom chips are built for one specific job, and that makes them a great fit for inference, since it's the same task repeated millions of times. A chip built just for that can answer each request more cheaply than a general-purpose GPU. CEO Hock Tan said OpenAI's first custom chip, Jalapeno, outperforms Nvidia's Grace Blackwell GPU on inference. Meta's custom chip is also built for inference at scale, and Broadcom is expected to start shipping it in the fiscal fourth quarter.

AMD Has Run Furthest, Broadcom Has Lagged

All three stocks have hit their all-time highs this year, but they've moved very differently since. AMD has been the clear winner, surging about 162% in 2026, far ahead of the S&P 500's ($SPX) roughly 11% gain. Strong demand for its server chips from AI agents and big deals with Meta and OpenAI pushed it to a record in October. Since then, it has dropped about 15% after a series of chip selloffs. AMZN stock is up about 16% this year and sits just 7% below its high, helped by AWS posting its fastest growth in years. AVGO stock has been the weakest of the three, up less than 2% this year and 29% below its peak. The stock slid after its June earnings, and worries about AI spending, along with the recent chip selloff, added to the pressure. So if Garman is right about inference, Broadcom might be the cheapest way to get in right now.

Broadcom Looks Like the Best Value of the Three

Amazon's forward price-to-earnings (P/E) of 27.80x looks far below its 5-year average of 158.13x, but that average is inflated by years when it barely made a profit. Its forward price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of 3.48x sits about 21% above average. EPS is expected to dip in 2027 after this year's boost from Anthropic gains, but the P/E still falls to about 15x by 2029.

AMD is the most expensive of the three. Its forward P/E of 62.89x is about 56% above its 5-year average, and its P/S ratio of 15.97x is about 81% above. The EPS helps explain that premium. Analysts expect earnings to grow 94% this fiscal year and more than double next year despite being compared to a really high base. That brings the P/E down to about 29x in 2027.

Broadcom looks like the best value. Its forward P/E of 27.39x is right in line with its 5-year average, and its forward P/S of 14.39x is just 9% above its average. The modest premium looks attractive next to its EPS trajectory. Analysts expect earnings to grow over 55% in each of the next three fiscal years. That brings its P/E down to about 10.5x by fiscal 2028. With strong growth and not much of a premium, I think Broadcom stands out among the three.

What Do Analysts Expect for AMZN, AMD, and AVGO Stocks?

As per Wall Street analysts, all three of these stocks hold a "Strong Buy" rating. AMZN stock's mean price target of $328.33 indicates 23% upside, which is smaller than it is for the other two, since AMZN sits much closer to its 52-week high than AMD or AVGO.

AMD has a mean price target of $660.37, indicating 19% upside. Its highest price target of $1,250 indicates a massive 126% upside, while the lowest price target of $460 is only 11% below where the stock currently sits.

AVGO stock's mean price target of $525.68 indicates the biggest upside of the three, at 48%. Even its lowest price target of $380 is well above the current share price. This is in line with what I said about AVGO stock standing out among the three.

news.Title: Amazon and Microsoft Lead the Cloud Market. One of Them Has Far Greater Upside.
news.Content:
Following the midterm elections and sweeping victories by candidates opposed to artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, there has been a lot of debate about which AI companies are best positioned in this new political climate.

However, the general consensus seems to be that leading cloud computing companies with strong businesses, like Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) and Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), are well positioned to benefit. Of these two, I think Amazon has a lot more upside. Here's why.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Cloud leaders

Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft's Azure are the two largest cloud providers. With the rise of AI, both companies have seen their cloud computing businesses take off.

Microsoft has recorded 13 straight quarters of 30% or more Azure growth, with a 48% increase last quarter to $33.2 billion. AWS has seen its growth accelerate to its fastest level in nearly five years, climbing 39% to $46 billion last quarter.

Microsoft's cloud business continues to be bolstered by its relationship with OpenAI. The company has priority access to OpenAI's models and products through 2032, and it owns a 27% stake in the maker of large language models. Microsoft also has huge commitments from OpenAI, which is a big reason for its huge $677 billion backlog.

Amazon also has a huge backlog, which more than doubled last quarter to $578 billion. The company has a close relationship with and a large stake in Anthropic, which has committed to spending over $100 billion with AWS. It also has a partnership with OpenAI around agentic AI. Amazon offers access to various third-party AI models through its Bedrock solution, which has helped drive growth.

What sets Amazon apart from Microsoft, though, is its custom chip business. Earlier this year, Amazon said its custom chips business -- which included its Trainium AI accelerator and Graviton custom ARM Holdings -based central processing unit (CPU) -- was a $20 billion run-rate business, or roughly $50 billion when including internal use.

Last quarter, it said its chip business more than doubled and that chip commitments have soared 20-fold. Demand is so high for its chips that it plans to start selling them to external data centers late next year. Amazon's custom chip business is both a revenue driver and a cost saving, helping it reduce inference costs and giving it better returns than with graphics processing units (GPUs).

Story Continues

Microsoft has developed its own custom chips, called Maia, and has its own ARM-based CPUs, but it's still very early, and it is nowhere near the scale of Amazon's chip business. As Amazon continues to growth this business and become less reliant on GPUs, I'd expect its two- to three-year AI infrastructure investment payback to move lower over time, giving it the edge over Microsoft.

Non-cloud businesses

Both Amazon and Microsoft also have strong non-cloud businesses. Microsoft is the leader in enterprise productivity software, and the company is seeing strong growth from a combination of more users deploying its AI Copilot assistants and a shift toward a hybrid model that includes AI usage. Last quarter, it saw an impressive eightfold increase in Copilot users to 50,000 seats.

Amazon is the leader in e-commerce. Any potential future reductions or elimination of tariffs should be great for this business. However, what it most impressive is how much operating leverage Amazon has been able to achieve through its use of robotics, automation, and AI. This is helping segment profitability grow much more quickly than revenue growth.

Amazon is the clear winner

While Microsoft's stock has upside from here, I think Amazon is the clear winner. Its AWS business is starting to see growth accelerate, and its custom chip business gives it a clear edge. Meanwhile, the shift in the political landscape could become a big catalyst if tariffs eventually go away or get reduced.

With both stocks trading at similar valuations, I prefer Amazon between the two and would be a buyer of the stock.

news.Title: Billionaire venture capitalist Vinod Khosla says judge AI by usage, not stock prices
news.Content: Wall Street wants to know whether AI is a bubble. Most of the worry is about who's paying for it. The companies leading the build-out are spending faster than their businesses bring in cash. Combined free cash flow for Amazon ( AMZN ), Alphabet ( GOOG , GOOGL ), Meta ( META ), Microsoft ( MSFT ), and Oracle ( ORCL ) fell to about minus $31 billion in the third quarter, according to Goldman Sachs. That's down from positive $37 billion to $62 billion a quarter through 2025. All that spending is a bet that people will use AI. Vinod Khosla, the billionaire Sun Microsystems co-founder and early OpenAI ( OPAI.PVT ) backer, says usage is the number to watch, not the stock market's mood swings. "It's not prices, it's actual usage," he said Tuesday on Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa Live . He measures it in tokens — the chunks of text AI models process. By that measure, the boom is real. Much of Big Tech's cash goes into computing power that AI labs rent to run their chatbots, and those labs' sales are taking off. OpenAI's quarterly revenue jumped nearly 50% to $10 billion . Khosla has history on his side. "When you look at internet traffic, you can't tell where the bubble was," he said. The share of Americans online kept climbing through the dot-com crash, from about 43% in 2000 to 59% in 2002, even as the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC ) lost 78%. The builders paid for the internet, and their customers cashed in Usage was never the problem. Overbuilding was. Telecoms spent more than $500 billion laying fiber, and with 85% of it sitting unused, the cost of bandwidth fell 90%, according to research by Kai Wu, founder of Sparkline Capital. Corning ( GLW ), which made the glass, fell 99% from 2000 to 2002 and didn't top its dot-com high until February, a month after it signed a deal worth up to $6 billion to supply fiber for Meta's AI data centers. The AI rush then more than doubled the stock by late June. The stock has since given back more than half, closing Tuesday near its 2000 peak. Cheap bandwidth was a gift to whoever came next. Netflix and Meta "came around and started using it," Wu said on Yahoo Finance's Stocks in Translation podcast. Alphabet, Meta, and Netflix ( NFLX ), none of which was public when the Nasdaq peaked, have added more than $5 trillion in market value since their first trades. Cisco ( CSCO ) is worth about $174 billion less than at its 2000 peak, per Yahoo Finance calculations. The roles have since flipped. "Instead of Global Crossing, we now have Google," Wu said. What AI's Netflix might look like Story Continues The bandwidth pattern is already showing up in AI. OpenAI cut its Luna model's price 80% after launch, and "we saw use go up almost 10x," CFO Sarah Friar said on the same show. If history rhymes, the winners will treat AI as a cheap ingredient. Wu's research finds early AI adopters are "more evenly spread across sectors" than in infrastructure stocks. "All of medicine is a massive application area," Khosla said. Unlike fiber, AI chips are still scarce. "There is going to be a silicon shortage for a couple of years," Khosla said. But chips wear out over years, not decades, Wu noted, giving builders less time to earn back what they spend. John Chambers, who ran Cisco through the dot-com boom and bust, told Yahoo Finance's Sozzi Unleashed this month that he expects "major train wrecks" this time too, because "rising tide does not raise all boats." news.Title: Prediction: 2 Stocks That Will Be Worth More Than Amazon 5 Years From Now
news.Content:
Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) is worth about $2.9 trillion as of this writing. That is a hard number to pass, and Amazon is not standing still. It is pouring money into data centers, custom chips, and robotics at a pace few companies can match.

That spending has to go somewhere, though. Every dollar Amazon spends on AI hardware flows to a supplier, and two of those suppliers sit in a position Amazon can't replicate. They collect from Amazon, and from every one of Amazon's rivals, at the same time. Those suppliers are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) and Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO), and I think both will pass Amazon in market value by 2031. Here's why.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Taiwan Semiconductor builds the chips everyone else designs

Taiwan Semiconductor, or TSMC, is a foundry. It doesn't design chips. It manufactures them for companies that do, which means it gets paid whether Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) wins, Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD) wins, or Amazon's in-house Trainium chip wins. Amazon designs Trainium to lower its reliance on Nvidia, and then it sends that design to TSMC to be built . The customer and the competitor end up at the same factory door.

TSMC is worth around $1.8 trillion today, so the gap between it and Amazon is the smaller of the two. What closes it, to me, is the Arizona project. TSMC has raised its planned U.S. investment from $12 billion in 2020 to $265 billion, and in July it said it intends to add more fabs for 2-nanometer and smaller chips plus more advanced packaging plants. The second Arizona fab is aiming for volume production in the second half of 2027, and the third is slated for the company's N2 and A16 processes before the decade ends.

Why does that matter beyond the headline? Advanced packaging, the step where chips get stacked and connected, is the bottleneck in AI hardware right now. Owning that step on U.S. soil, next to the customers who need it, turns TSMC from an overseas supplier into local infrastructure.

Broadcom is the stock that has to grow the most

Broadcom sits at around $1.56 trillion, which means it needs to gain about 70% on Amazon over five years, before accounting for Amazon's own growth. That is the harder call, and it is the one I feel better about.

Broadcom builds custom AI accelerators, which it calls XPUs, for the companies that want an alternative to buying Nvidia chips off the shelf. On Oct. 26, Bank of America (NYSE: BAC), Blackstone (NYSE: BX), Citi (NYSE: C), and Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) announced a $63 billion financing structure to buy Broadcom accelerators and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic, with deliveries starting in 2027. Four of the largest financial firms in the world built a vehicle to finance one customer's purchases of one chipmaker's hardware. Broadcom is backing part of the deal with residual value support, which tells you how confident it is that the gear holds its worth.

Story Continues

That same month, Broadcom rolled out new networking products at the OCP Global Summit. Networking is the quieter half of its story. When thousands of accelerators run as one system, the switches connecting them matter as much as the chips, and Broadcom is one of a few companies that sells both.

What investors should take from this

Passing Amazon is not the point of owning either stock. The point is understanding where AI money goes once it leaves the companies building data centers. Amazon has to win its own race. TSMC and Broadcom get paid no matter who wins, as long as the race keeps running. That said, the AI race has hit some turbulence, especially in the last couple of months.

Look at Nvidia this week for proof. On Thursday last week, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index had its worst day since April 2025, the Nasdaq Composite closed in correction territory, and Nvidia shed more than 9% on fears that a new Congress could slow the data center build-out.

Then, on Sunday, Nvidia's board announced an independent review into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The stock opened down about 8% on Monday, erasing about $350 billion in value before clawing some of it back. None of that had anything to do with chip demand. It was politics one day, and a governance headline the next. The most valuable company in the world still moved like a small-cap.

That is what a market finding its footing looks like. The AI trade is real, but it is not yet steady, and anyone buying TSMC or Broadcom on this thesis should expect more weeks like this one.

news.Title: History Says This Is What Will Happen to Sandisk Stock After Its 8-for-1 Split
news.Content:
Since separating from Western Digital in February 2025, Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) has benefited from soaring demand for data storage, particularly from artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

However, the company's latest announcement has introduced an interesting twist. On Oct. 29, Sandisk announced an 8-for-1 stock split , scheduled to take effect after the market closes on Nov. 19.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Normally, stock splits generate excitement among investors. But Sandisk stock has actually plunged since the announcement. Between Oct. 29 and Nov. 9, Sandisk fell from $1,330 to $886, a 33% decline.

Let's examine how stock splits work, what happened with other semiconductor companies that split their stock in recent years, and whether Sandisk is worth buying before its upcoming split.

Why Sandisk is splitting its stock

A stock split increases the number of outstanding shares while proportionately reducing their price. For example, an investor holding one Sandisk share worth $800 before the split would subsequently own eight shares worth approximately $100 apiece post-split. The investment would still be worth $800.

As investors can see, stock splits don't create shareholder value, change a company's earnings, or alter its market capitalization. So, why do companies pursue them?

One reason is accessibility. Lower share prices in terms of absolute dollars can make stocks more appealing to retail investors who prefer purchasing whole shares rather than fractional shares. That's precisely what Sandisk wants to accomplish. Management explained that its stock price has appreciated substantially since the Western Digital spinoff, making a split attractive for a broader base of investors and employees participating in the company's stock purchase program.

The announcement accompanied impressive financial results. During its fiscal first quarter of 2027, Sandisk generated $11 billion in revenue, increasing 378% year over year and 23% sequentially. Adjusted earnings per share reached $49.51 per share compared with just $1.22 during the same period last year.

These results reflect robust demand for NAND flash memory, particularly as data centers require more storage capacity. However, Sandisk's post-earnings sell-off suggests investors are becoming more concerned about valuation and the sustainability of memory pricing.

Story Continues

Image source: The Motley Fool.

What Nvidia and Broadcom reveal about semiconductor stock splits

In June 2024, Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) completed a 10-for-1 split after its shares surged alongside demand for its GPUs. Nvidia subsequently experienced prolonged volatility, including a sharp pullback during the summer of 2024. Nevertheless, its shares eventually reached higher levels as revenue and earnings continued expanding.

Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) followed with its own 10-for-1 split in July 2024. Similar to Nvidia, Broadcom benefited from growing AI infrastructure spending, particularly demand for custom accelerators and networking technology. Its stock also experienced fleeting fluctuations after the split before benefiting from continued acceleration in its AI semiconductor business.

NVDA data by YCharts

What will happen to Sandisk stock after the split?

I wouldn't be surprised to see Sandisk experience a short-term rebound once its shares begin trading at a lower nominal price. Using the Nov. 9 closing price of $886, the theoretical post-split share price would be around $111, assuming no additional price movement. That's considerably more accessible than a stock trading near $900.

The lower price could attract more investors who previously considered Sandisk too expensive to purchase in whole-share increments. However, increased interest from retail investors doesn't necessarily translate into sustainable stock price appreciation.

Here's where I'd exercise caution: Sandisk's recent financial results have been historic, but the memory industry is also cyclical. Demand for data center storage is growing rapidly, while supply constraints are contributing to higher average selling prices. Those conditions support Sandisk's margins and profitability... for now.

Investors need to understand the difference between a stock becoming cheaper per share and becoming cheaper based on valuation. An 8-for-1 split doesn't reduce Sandisk's price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio. If investors bid up shares after the split, they could ironically end up paying an even higher valuation for a business whose profits are sensitive to memory pricing cycles.

Sandisk could enjoy a brief rally around the time of its split, especially after the recent sell-off. However, given what happened with Nvidia and Broadcom, history suggests the momentum will not be sustainable without continued earnings growth.

Nvidia and Broadcom ultimately rewarded shareholders because their underlying businesses grew, not because dividing their shares magically created value. Sandisk could follow a similar path if demand for its NAND flash storage remains strong. For now, though, I think patience is the more prudent strategy.

news.Title: AXTI's AI Data Center Boom: Can Substrate Demand Sustain Growth?
news.Content:
AXT, Inc. AXTI is seeing accelerating demand for its indium phosphide (InP) substrates as hyperscalers expand AI data centers and deploy increasingly GPU-dense computing systems. These facilities require faster optical links to move growing volumes of data, making InP-based lasers and photodetectors increasingly important.

The transition to 800G and 1.6T optical transceivers is a major catalyst. AXT's InP revenues reached $54.3 million in third-quarter 2026, primarily driven by data center applications. Total revenues surged 162% year over year and 54% sequentially to a record $73.4 million. Non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 56.1% from 45% in the preceding quarter, benefiting from higher volumes, favorable product mix and increasing InP prices.

Demand extends across geographies. Management believes AXT's materials are deployed at multiple U.S. hyperscalers, while China's growing AI investments have accelerated demand for InP-based lasers. The company's backlog exceeded $500 million, with customers on allocation as demand outstripped available supply. AXT surpassed its 2026 goal of doubling InP capacity and plans further expansion in 2027.

The shift toward higher-value 4-inch wafers, emerging 6-inch capabilities and future co-packaged optics could add to this momentum. Although scaling production remains critical, surging optical connectivity requirements and a substantial backlog suggest AI data center expansion can sustain AXT's substrate-driven revenue growth.

Rivals Benefiting From the Trend

Coherent COHR is benefiting from growing demand for InP-based lasers, photodiodes and 1.6T optical transceivers. Coherent reported Datacenter & Communications revenues of $1.95 billion in first-quarter fiscal 2027, up 79% year over year. With advanced 6-inch InP fabrication capabilities, Coherent is expanding its optical manufacturing footprint. However, its substrate supply agreement with AXT also makes it an important customer rather than solely a competitor.

Lumentum LITE is capitalizing on AI data center investments through its InP lasers, optical circuit switches and cloud networking solutions. Lumentum reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenues of $1.26 billion, up 136.5% year over year, driven by strong optical infrastructure demand. Lumentum is also expanding domestic InP manufacturing capacity while maintaining a long-term substrate supply agreement with AXT, reinforcing their complementary positions in the optical connectivity ecosystem.
